66435.recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍紅血球大很多的橢圓形組織球，單一小而深染的細胞核，細胞質豐富、藍色，充滿纖細波浪狀條紋，像揉皺的面紙或洋蔥皮；這種條紋狀細胞質是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）的標誌。
features: Very large oval histiocyte, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Single small, dense nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin, slightly off-center; low N:C ratio
Abundant blue cytoplasm with prominent fine wavy fibrillary striations (crumpled tissue paper appearance)
No foamy vacuoles, discrete blue granules, or phagocytosed cells
Background of overlapping red cells in a thick area of the smear
66435.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large oval histiocyte surrounded by overlapping red cells. The cell has a single small, dense nucleus with clumped chromatin and abundant blue cytoplasm containing fine, wavy fibrillary striations resembling crumpled tissue paper. Foamy vacuolation, ceroid granules, and hemophagocytosis are absent. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; enzyme assay for glucocerebrosidase or GBA1 genotyping is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphology is nearly identical, so separation depends on the underlying disorder, AFB stain, and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly foamy, soap-bubble cytoplasm instead of fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than a wrinkled striated texture.

65667.recognize_zh: 甲苯胺藍（Toluidine blue）染色下，多數細胞含粗大、深紫紅色的異染性（metachromasia）顆粒，對比淡藍色細胞質與細胞核；另見少數無顆粒、較大的淡藍色細胞，符合母細胞與嗜鹼性球混合的 CSF 抹片。
features: Cytospin preparation stained with toluidine blue showing numerous cells with coarse metachromatic granules staining deep purple to magenta
Granules often obscure the nucleus and cluster around it, typical of basophils (and possibly mast-cell–differentiated cells)
Admixed larger cells with pale blue, agranular or sparsely granulated cytoplasm and round nuclei, consistent with blasts
Some cells show only a few metachromatic granules in otherwise immature-appearing cytoplasm (partially granulated blasts)
Clean background with scattered extruded granules
65667.describe_en: Toluidine blue–stained CSF cytospin shows a cellular specimen containing numerous cells with coarse metachromatic purple-magenta granules, consistent with basophils, many of which obscure nuclear detail. Interspersed are larger cells with pale blue, largely agranular cytoplasm and round nuclei, some containing sparse metachromatic granules, in keeping with blasts showing basophilic differentiation. Together with the clinical history of CML, the findings are consistent with CNS involvement by myeloid blast phase with prominent basophilia.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are also toluidine blue metachromatic but are larger, round-to-spindle with a central non-lobed nucleus and evenly packed granules, and are tryptase/CD117 bright with CD25; basophils are smaller, lobulated and CD123+/HLA-DR−, requiring flow or IHC to separate.
Eosinophil granules are not metachromatic with toluidine blue (they stain orange-red on Romanowsky stains) and eosinophils are typically bilobed.
APL granules are azurophilic and MPO-strong but not metachromatic, and Auer rod bundles rather than toluidine blue positivity are characteristic.

66179.recognize_zh: CSF 抹片（1a–1b）中可見許多偏心核、細胞質深藍帶空泡、核形不規則甚至多核的非典型漿細胞，部分有明顯核仁；流式（2）顯示 CD138+/CD38+ 族群，細胞質輕鏈 lambda 限制（99.97%）、CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性，確認為單株性漿細胞，符合骨髓瘤侵犯中樞神經。
features: Panels 1a–1b (CSF cytospin): numerous large atypical plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Nuclei are irregular, lobated or binucleate/multinucleate with visible nucleoli (anaplastic/plasmablastic features)
Prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional perinuclear hof
Background of scattered red cells without a significant reactive lymphocytic component
Panel 2 (flow cytometry): CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells with cytoplasmic lambda restriction (kappa 0%, lambda 99.97%)
Aberrant phenotype: CD19 negative, CD56 positive
66179.describe_en: CSF cytospin preparations show numerous large atypical plasma cells with abundant basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm, eccentric irregular to lobated nuclei, occasional binucleation and conspicuous nucleoli, consistent with immature/anaplastic morphology. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD38+/CD138+ plasma cell population with cytoplasmic lambda light chain restriction and an aberrant CD19-negative, CD56-positive phenotype. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by plasma cell myeloma (lambda-restricted, concordant with the known IgA lambda myeloma).

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in CSF (infection, demyelination)
ddx.vs: Reactive CSF plasma cells are small and mature with polytypic kappa/lambda expression and CD19+/CD56−, unlike these atypical lambda-restricted CD19−/CD56+ cells.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma / DLBCL with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; the known history of IgA lambda myeloma with matching light chain and CD56+ phenotype favors myeloma, while PBL is often EBER+ and arises without a preceding myeloma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in CSF
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and lack CD38/CD138 with light chain restriction, whereas these are discohesive plasma cells with monotypic light chain.
Macrophages have grey-blue foamy cytoplasm with folded central nuclei and no perinuclear hof or CD138/cytoplasmic light chain expression.

66243.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見兩大團緊密聚在一起的分葉核中性球（左側與右下），另有一小團中性球夾雜單核球樣細胞；紅血球與血小板本身正常，這種中性球成團（neutrophil aggregation）會讓自動血球計數器低估白血球數，需人工看片確認。
features: Two large tight aggregates of segmented neutrophils (left mid-field and lower right) and a smaller aggregate at upper left
Neutrophils within clumps show intact segmented nuclei and granular cytoplasm without obvious phagocytosed material
Upper left aggregate includes a larger mononuclear cell with basophilic cytoplasm (possibly monocyte or immature granulocyte) adjacent to a separate large mononuclear cell
Scattered single lymphocyte (lower center) and platelets adequate in number
Red cells normocytic with mild anisocytosis; no platelet satellitism or clumping
66243.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-intermediate power shows several tight aggregates of segmented neutrophils, including two large clusters, with occasional admixed mononuclear cells. Individual neutrophils show intact nuclear segmentation, and a single lymphocyte is present outside the clumps. Red cells are normocytic with mild anisocytosis, and platelets appear adequate without clumping. Findings represent neutrophil aggregation, which can cause spurious leukopenia on automated counts; it may reflect in vivo neutrophil activation in sepsis or an EDTA-dependent in vitro artifact, and repeat counts in a citrate or heparin sample with a manual estimate are advised.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps consist of aggregated platelets or platelets rimming neutrophils, whereas these clusters are composed of neutrophils themselves.
Neoplastic clusters show immature nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli, unlike these mature segmented neutrophils.
Cells piled at the feathered edge are distributed along the edge with other cell types, whereas these are discrete tight neutrophil clumps in a well-spread monolayer.

ddx.dx: Leukoagglutination due to cold or EDTA-dependent antibodies
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; persistence in citrate/heparin or at 37°C favors in vivo activation, while resolution favors an EDTA or cold-dependent artifact.

66051.recognize_zh: 右側細胞為圓形未分葉的核，細胞質布滿粗大、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒並部分覆蓋於核上，屬嗜鹼性骨髓細胞（basophilic myelocyte）；左側為核呈腎形、顆粒不明顯的後骨髓細胞，背景為 CML 周邊血。
features: Right cell: medium-sized granulocyte with a round-to-oval, non-segmented eccentric nucleus
Dense, coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules filling the cytoplasm and partially overlying the nucleus
Nuclear chromatin moderately condensed with visible nuclear outline beneath the granules
Left cell: oval to slightly indented nucleus with fine chromatin and pale grayish-blue cytoplasm lacking prominent granules
Background of normochromic red cells without other cells in this field
66051.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two immature granulocytes adjacent to each other on a background of normochromic red cells. The cell on the right has a round, non-segmented nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark basophilic granules that partially obscure the nucleus, consistent with a basophilic myelocyte. The cell on the left has an oval, slightly indented nucleus with fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm lacking prominent granulation, consistent with a metamyelocyte. In the context of BCR::ABL1-positive disease, circulating immature basophils and left-shifted granulocytes are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: A mature basophil has a segmented or bilobed nucleus largely obscured by granules, whereas this cell has a round, non-segmented myelocyte-type nucleus.
Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and more uniform, densely packed granules, are rare in blood, and express CD117 and tryptase.
Eosinophilic precursors contain refractile orange-red granules (sometimes with a few dark immature granules) rather than dark purple-black basophilic granules.
Toxic neutrophils have a segmented nucleus and finer dark granules that do not overlie the nucleus as heavily.

65987.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被單一形態的小型淋巴細胞瀰漫取代，抹片見核稍不規則、染色質濃縮的小至中型淋巴細胞；免疫染色 CD20、cyclin D1、SOX11 陽性，FISH 見 IGH::CCND1 融合訊號及 KMT2A 分離訊號，符合合併 KMT2A 重排的被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: marrow biopsy diffusely replaced by monotonous small lymphoid cells with dark round-to-slightly irregular nuclei
Panel B: aspirate with small-to-medium lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contours and scant cytoplasm
Panel C: diffuse membranous CD20 positivity
Panel D: nuclear cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity in the lymphoid cells
Panel E: optical genome mapping circos plot showing t(11;14) and a complex t(6;11;14)
Panel F: FISH with IGH::CCND1 dual-fusion signals and a KMT2A break-apart split signal pattern
65987.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows near-complete replacement by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphoid cells. The aspirate smear shows small-to-medium lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contours, and scant cytoplasm, without blastoid features. The infiltrate is CD20 positive with nuclear cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression. Optical genome mapping and FISH demonstrate IGH::CCND1 fusion and a KMT2A rearrangement. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by mantle cell lymphoma with an accompanying KMT2A rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and are CD23+/CD200+ and cyclin D1/SOX11 negative, lacking t(11;14).
B-ALL blasts have fine chromatin and are CD34/TdT positive, often CD10 negative CD19+, whereas this infiltrate is TdT/CD34 negative and cyclin D1 positive.
MZL cells have more cytoplasm and monocytoid/plasmacytoid features and are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
Myeloma with t(11;14) expresses cyclin D1 but consists of CD138+ plasma cells or lymphoplasmacytoid cells and lacks CD20/SOX11 with a mature B-cell phenotype.

65987.stain: H&E, Giemsa; IHC CD20, cyclin D1, SOX11; FISH; OGM

65923.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核至少分成六葉，各葉以細絲相連，細胞質淡而帶細顆粒，即分葉過多嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil，≥6 葉即可判定）。
features: Neutrophil of normal to slightly increased size
Nucleus with at least six discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Condensed, clumped chromatin in each lobe
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; no toxic granulation or Döhle bodies
Red cells with overlapping aggregates and scattered platelets
65923.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a nucleus composed of at least six discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments, within pale finely granular cytoplasm without toxic changes. Background red cells show overlapping aggregates without obvious macro-ovalocytes, and platelets are present. No blasts or immature granulocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil; in CML this may reflect hydroxyurea therapy, and vitamin B12/folate deficiency should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows multiple hypersegmented neutrophils together with macro-ovalocytes and low B12 or folate.
Drug effect is morphologically identical and is separated by treatment history, commonly with macrocytosis.
This rare autosomal dominant trait affects most neutrophils lifelong without anemia or nutritional deficiency.
Macropolycytes are about twice normal size with a large multilobed nucleus, reflecting tetraploidy.

65859.recognize_zh: 中央一顆成熟嗜中性球，核分成兩個圓形葉並以細絲相連，呈夾鼻眼鏡狀（pince-nez），染色質粗塊狀凝集，細胞質顆粒正常存在；這是低分葉（Pelger-Huët 型）嗜中性球的典型樣子。
features: Mature-sized neutrophil with bilobed nucleus of two round lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge (pince-nez)
Coarse, markedly clumped mature chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with retained neutrophilic granulation (not hypogranular)
Background red cells normocytic with drying-artifact refractile centers; scattered platelets and platelet clumps
65859.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes connected by a thin filament (pince-nez configuration) and coarsely clumped chromatin. The cytoplasm is well granulated. Red cells show drying artifact only, and platelets are present. The finding represents a Pelger-Huët-type hyposegmented neutrophil; in this patient with leukocytosis and infection, it is consistent with a reactive pseudo-Pelger-Huët change, although inherited anomaly and myelodysplasia should be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; the inherited form affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly, is lifelong, and is found in family members, whereas pseudo-Pelger change is acquired and usually partial.
MDS-associated pseudo-Pelger cells are typically accompanied by hypogranular neutrophils, cytopenias and other dysplastic lineages.
A band has a continuous, uniformly thick U- or C-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin rather than two round clumped lobes joined by a thin filament.

64835.recognize_zh: 低倍（20x）血液抹片中散佈大量小而深染的核，是循環中的有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），並可見多量偏藍灰色的多染性紅血球（polychromasia）與紅血球大小不一，提示胎兒嚴重溶血或紅血球生成壓力。
features: Low-power (20x) peripheral blood smear with numerous small cells bearing dense, pyknotic dark nuclei (nucleated red blood cells)
Prominent polychromasia: many larger bluish-grey red cells
Anisocytosis and poikilocytosis
Nucleated red cells far outnumber leukocytes in this field
Scattered platelet-like clumps; fine cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
64835.describe_en: Low-power examination of the peripheral blood smear shows marked erythroblastemia with numerous circulating nucleated red cells distributed throughout the field. Red cells show prominent polychromasia with anisocytosis and poikilocytosis. Detailed assessment of leukocytes, platelets and red cell inclusions is limited at this magnification. The findings indicate a brisk erythropoietic response to severe anemia, such as hemolysis; in this fetus they are consistent with the hemolytic anemia of congenital erythropoietic porphyria, which is not specific morphologically and requires porphyrin studies.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (alloimmune)
ddx.vs: HDFN shows a similar erythroblastic picture but has a positive direct antiglobulin test and maternal alloantibodies, with no porphyrin fluorescence.
Hb Bart hydrops shows marked hypochromia, microcytosis and target cells, with hemoglobin analysis demonstrating Hb Bart.

ddx.dx: Congenital infection (such as CMV, syphilis) or transient abnormal myelopoiesis
ddx.vs: These show a leukoerythroblastic picture with immature myeloid cells or blasts rather than isolated erythroid expansion.
Parvovirus causes red cell aplasia with reticulocytopenia and few polychromatic cells, unlike this brisk regenerative picture.

65539.recognize_zh: 六格組合圖：A–C 的 H&E 顯示皮下脂肪小葉被淋巴細胞浸潤，細胞沿著脂肪細胞邊緣排成環狀（rimming），B 圖可見混雜漿細胞；D、E 的 CD7 與 CD2 在圍繞脂肪的 T 細胞上仍保持陽性（沒有 pan-T 抗原喪失）；F 的 CD123 可見成團的漿細胞樣樹突細胞。漿細胞多、CD123+ pDC 聚集、T 細胞無異常，支持紅斑性狼瘡脂膜炎（lupus panniculitis），而非 SPTCL。
features: Panel A (H&E, low power): lobular panniculitis with a dense lymphoid infiltrate throughout subcutaneous fat
Panels B–C (H&E): small to medium lymphocytes rimming adipocytes, admixed plasma cells, without marked cytologic atypia
Panels D–E (IHC): rimming T cells retain CD7 and CD2 (no pan-T-cell antigen loss)
Panel F (IHC CD123): clustered aggregates of CD123-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cells, highlighted in the inset
No obvious karyorrhectic necrosis or large atypical cells evident at this resolution
65539.describe_en: Composite of subcutaneous tissue biopsy. H&E sections show a lobular panniculitis with a dense lymphoid infiltrate that rims individual adipocytes, accompanied by scattered plasma cells; the lymphocytes are small to medium without striking atypia. Immunohistochemistry shows that the rimming T cells retain CD7 and CD2, without pan-T-cell antigen loss, and CD123 highlights clustered aggregates of plasmacytoid dendritic cells. The combination of plasma cells, CD123-positive pDC clusters and a non-aberrant T-cell phenotype favors lupus erythematosus panniculitis over subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: SPTCL shows atypical CD8+/TIA-1+/βF1+ T cells rimming adipocytes with high Ki-67 rim, frequent loss of CD5/CD7, few plasma cells and absent CD123+ pDC clusters.
γδ lymphoma involves dermis and epidermis as well as fat, is TCRγ positive and CD4/CD8 double negative, and shows angioinvasion and necrosis.

ddx.dx: Erythema nodosum and other septal panniculitis
ddx.vs: Erythema nodosum is predominantly septal with Miescher granulomas rather than a dense lobular lymphoid infiltrate rimming adipocytes.
BPDCN shows sheets of monotonous CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ blasts in the dermis, not small reactive pDC clusters within a mixed lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate.

65091.recognize_zh: 40 倍下萎縮生發中心內有多個大型細胞，核大、空泡狀、核膜清楚且有雙核或多葉核，夾在粉紅色玻璃樣基質與同心圓排列的扁長細胞之間，外圍是小淋巴球；這些核大不規則的細胞就是發育異常的濾泡樹突細胞，符合透明血管型 Castleman 病。
features: Regressed germinal center with concentric, whorled arrangement of elongated stromal and dendritic cells
Scattered large follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei, distinct nuclear membranes and small nucleoli
Binucleate and multilobated dysplastic FDC nuclei, some with smudgy hyperchromasia
Eosinophilic hyaline material and small capillaries within the germinal center
Surrounding small mature lymphocytes of the mantle zone; no mitotic-rich centroblast population
65091.describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node follicle shows a regressed germinal center composed of whorled stromal cells, small capillaries and eosinophilic hyaline material, surrounded by small mature mantle lymphocytes. Scattered within the germinal center are follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular, irregular, binucleate or multilobated nuclei and small nucleoli, some with smudged chromatin. There are no cohesive sheets of atypical cells and no Reed-Sternberg-like macronucleoli. Findings are consistent with dysplastic follicular dendritic cells within a regressed germinal center, supporting hyaline-vascular unicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: FDC sarcoma forms expansile sheets, storiform or fascicular growth of atypical CD21/CD23+ cells that efface nodal architecture rather than isolated atypical FDCs confined to regressed follicles.
Reed-Sternberg cells carry large inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ within a mixed inflammatory background, which is absent here.
Carcinoma cells are cohesive, often sinusoidal in distribution and keratin-positive, unlike scattered CD21+ dendritic cells.

65155.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一個大型細胞團，中央被巨大淡染的空泡（黏液）撐開，三個深染新月形細胞核被擠壓到周邊，形成印戒樣（signet ring）排列，背景乾淨，提示轉移性腺癌伴印戒細胞分化。
features: Large rounded cell group, several times the size of nearby cells
Central voluminous pale, finely vacuolated/mucin-like cytoplasmic space
Three dense, crescentic hyperchromatic nuclei compressed to the periphery
Rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm at the periphery
Clean, paucicellular background; image slightly out of focus, limiting nuclear detail
65155.describe_en: Ascitic fluid smear shows a large, rounded cluster in which a voluminous central pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasmic space compresses three hyperchromatic, crescent-shaped nuclei to the periphery, beneath a rim of basophilic cytoplasm, producing a signet-ring configuration. It is uncertain at this focus whether this represents a single multinucleated cell or a tight cluster of cells around a shared mucin vacuole. The background is otherwise paucicellular, and nuclear detail is limited by focus. Findings are suggestive of metastatic adenocarcinoma with signet-ring cell features; cell block with mucin stains and immunohistochemistry (e.g., cytokeratin, MOC31/BerEP4, calretinin) are required to confirm.

ddx.vs: Degenerative mesothelial vacuoles are usually multiple and small with a central round nucleus and calretinin/WT1 positivity, rather than one large mucin vacuole crushing crescentic nuclei.
Histiocytes have bland reniform nuclei and foamy cytoplasm with CD68/CD163 positivity and are mucicarmine-negative.
Signet-ring lymphoma cells are discohesive, single lymphoid cells with immunoglobulin vacuoles and are CD45/CD20-positive, not cohesive clusters.

65027.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片白血球極多，顆粒球從前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞到桿狀與分節嗜中性球各階段都有，且嗜鹼性球（充滿深紫黑色粗顆粒）明顯增加，母細胞少，呈典型的慢性骨髓性白血病慢性期血片。
features: Marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at all stages of maturation (left shift without a maturation gap)
Prominent myelocytes and metamyelocytes with band and segmented neutrophils
Absolute basophilia: numerous cells packed with coarse dark purple-black granules
Occasional promyelocytes and few blasts, not predominant
Scattered eosinophilic and dysplasia-free granulocytes; background red cells appear thin and packed in thick areas
65027.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of several fields) shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with a myelocyte peak and numerous metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Basophils are strikingly increased, and occasional promyelocytes and rare blasts are present without a blast predominance. Significant dysplasia is not evident. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase; confirmation by BCR::ABL1 RT-PCR or FISH and blast and basophil enumeration for phase assignment are required.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show neutrophils with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies, few myelocytes and no basophilia or eosinophilia, and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypolobation, hypogranularity) with minimal basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1, often with SETBP1 or ASXL1 mutations.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils and bands with <10% immature granulocytes, no basophilia, and a CSF3R mutation.

64963.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中散布多個頭盔狀、三角形與新月形的紅血球碎片（schistocytes），並有數顆偏藍色的大型多染性紅血球（polychromasia），整個視野幾乎看不到血小板，這組合就是微血管病性溶血，符合 TTP。
features: Numerous schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular and crescent-shaped fragments
Polychromatic macrocytes (larger bluish-gray red cells) indicating reticulocytosis
Two small, densely stained blue-purple red cells without central pallor (polychromatic microspherocyte-like forms)
Marked thrombocytopenia with only rare platelets in the field
No leukocytes, blasts or red cell agglutination in this field
64963.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cell fragments, including helmet cells and triangular schistocytes, accompanied by polychromatic macrocytes indicating a reticulocyte response. Platelets are markedly decreased, with only rare forms identified. No red cell agglutination or spherocyte-predominant picture is seen. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia, in keeping with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura given ADAMTS13 activity <5%.

ddx.vs: HUS shows identical schistocytes but is associated with severe renal failure, Shiga toxin or complement dysregulation and ADAMTS13 activity >10%.
DIC has schistocytes with prolonged PT/aPTT and low fibrinogen, whereas TTP coagulation studies are usually near normal.
Valve hemolysis shows schistocytes typically without severe thrombocytopenia and with a relevant cardiac history.
AIHA shows spherocytes rather than fragments with a positive direct antiglobulin test.

64771.recognize_zh: 左上角仍保留造血骨髓，其餘被纖維間質中大型多角形腫瘤細胞巢取代；中央細胞巢的細胞質濃稠嗜酸性、邊界清楚並有細胞間角化樣排列，是鱗狀分化的直接證據。
features: Residual hematopoietic marrow with erythroid and myeloid elements in the upper left corner
Cohesive nests of large polygonal cells with abundant dense glassy eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Central nest showing keratinizing, swirled eosinophilic material consistent with squamous differentiation
Pleomorphic oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Infiltrative smaller nests within desmoplastic stroma with scattered adipocytes
64771.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows residual hematopoietic marrow at the periphery of the field, with the remainder replaced by desmoplastic stroma containing infiltrative nests of large polygonal tumor cells. The tumor cells have abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct cell borders and pleomorphic nuclei with nucleoli, and the central nests show keratinization. The findings are consistent with metastatic keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and platelet-granular cytoplasm and lie singly or in loose clusters within hematopoietic marrow, not in desmoplastic stroma with keratinization.
Adenocarcinoma lacks keratinization and intercellular bridges and forms glands, and is p40/CK5/6 negative.
Epithelioid histiocytes have pale indistinct cytoplasm with slipper-shaped bland nuclei and are CD68-positive, cytokeratin-negative.

64707.recognize_zh: 高倍下數個大型母細胞核內有一塊淡染、邊界清楚的核凹陷區（nuclear invagination），使細胞核呈杯狀（cup-like），凹陷處面積超過核的四分之一，染色質細緻、細胞質藍色無顆粒，是 NPM1 突變 AML 的特徵性形態。
features: Large blasts with a high N:C ratio and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Cup-like nuclei: a sharply demarcated pale invagination at one pole occupying more than 25% of the nuclear area
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Agranular cytoplasm without visible Auer rods
Background red cells and a platelet in a smear preparation
64707.describe_en: The smear shows several large blasts with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a narrow rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts display a sharply outlined, pale nuclear invagination at one side of the nucleus that occupies more than a quarter of the nuclear area, giving a cup-like or fish-mouth appearance. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with cup-like blasts, which are strongly associated with AML with NPM1 mutation, frequently with concurrent FLT3-ITD; mutation testing is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL blasts have bilobed or butterfly-shaped folded nuclei and faint granules with PML::RARA, whereas cup-like blasts have a round nucleus with a single pale invagination.
Promonocytes show delicately folded, convoluted nuclei with gray cytoplasm and fine granules and are NSE positive, rather than a discrete cup-shaped invagination.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with nuclear clefts
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and small nuclear clefts, and flow shows TdT with B/T lineage markers, whereas cup-like AML blasts are CD34-negative myeloid blasts.
Artifactual clearing is irregular and affects cells unevenly, whereas cup-like invaginations are sharply demarcated and repeated across many blasts.

64323.recognize_zh: D 圖中壞死、疏鬆區域內有數個鮮紅色、細長菱形/針狀的結晶，即 Charcot-Leyden 結晶；搭配 C 圖滿是嗜伊紅性顆粒細胞質的高細胞性骨髓，提示伴嗜伊紅球增多的骨髓腫瘤。
features: Aspirate (A): left-shifted granulocytic cells including promyelocytes/myelocytes and eosinophilic precursors; blasts not conspicuous
Trephine low power (B): markedly hypercellular marrow filling intertrabecular spaces
Trephine high power (C): sheets of myeloid cells with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, consistent with increased eosinophils and precursors
Trephine (D): loosely cohesive, degenerating/necrotic area containing bright eosinophilic, elongated bipyramidal (diamond/needle-shaped) Charcot-Leyden crystals
64323.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted granulocytic hyperplasia with eosinophilic precursors and no conspicuous increase in blasts. The trephine biopsy is markedly hypercellular (near 100%), with sheets of myeloid cells showing abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm consistent with increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors. A focus of necrosis contains several brightly eosinophilic, elongated bipyramidal crystals consistent with Charcot-Leyden crystals. In the setting of PDGFRB rearrangement by FISH, findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRB rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CML shows similar granulocytic hyperplasia with eosinophils and basophils and can contain Charcot-Leyden crystals, but it is excluded by absence of BCR::ABL1.
Reactive eosinophilia lacks marked marrow hypercellularity with a left shift and splenomegaly, and has no clonal rearrangement such as PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2.
Mastocytosis shows compact spindled CD117+/tryptase+ mast cell aggregates and KIT D816V, rather than a pure eosinophilic myeloid proliferation.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are sharply defined, bright pink, bipyramidal and needle-like, whereas bone fragments are lamellar and artifacts are irregular and non-geometric.

64131.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞緊密群聚成團，大小不一、核深染且呈雲朵狀或不規則分葉，部分核裸露，背景為纖維化與梭形細胞呈串流狀（streaming）排列，符合原發性骨髓纖維化。
features: Dense cluster of atypical megakaryocytes of variable size
Hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like, or irregularly folded nuclei with abnormal lobation
Abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm; occasional small megakaryocytes and naked nuclei
Background stromal fibrosis with elongated spindle cells and streaming of hematopoietic cells
Scattered granulocytic and erythroid cells between fibrotic strands
64131.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a dense cluster of atypical megakaryocytes with marked size variation and hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei with abnormal lobation. The surrounding marrow shows fibrotic stroma with spindled cells and streaming of residual hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with atypical clustered megakaryocytes and marrow fibrosis, supportive of primary myelofibrosis, overt fibrotic stage; reticulin grading and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows loosely scattered large megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and no significant reticulin fibrosis.
Morphology can be identical; distinction relies on a documented prior diagnosis of PV or ET.
Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive epithelial nests and are cytokeratin positive, while megakaryocytes are CD61/CD42b positive.

ddx.dx: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis or acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34-positive blasts and small dysplastic megakaryocytes rather than mature bulbous forms.

64067.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片：兩隻大腳趾外側甲溝各長出一團鮮紅至暗紫色、易出血且表面結痂的肉芽樣隆起（左趾在內側緣、右趾在外側緣），外觀像化膿性肉芽腫（pyogenic granuloma），在服用 ibrutinib 的病人符合藥物相關甲周肉芽腫。
features: Clinical photograph of both great toes
Left great toe: bright red to violaceous, moist, friable granulation-tissue nodule along the nail fold with dark crust
Right great toe: larger exophytic red-purple crusted vascular nodule at the lateral nail fold overlapping the nail plate
Nail plates otherwise intact and pale without discoloration
Minimal surrounding erythema and no obvious purulence
64067.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows both great toes with exophytic, bright red to violaceous, friable and crusted granulation-tissue nodules arising from the nail folds, larger on the lateral fold of the right great toe. The nail plates are intact, and there is little surrounding erythema or purulence. This is a clinical rather than microscopic image. In a patient receiving ibrutinib, the bilateral periungual lesions are consistent with drug-associated pyogenic granuloma-like periungual granulation tissue.

ddx.vs: Ingrown toenail is typically unilateral and associated with a penetrating nail spicule, whereas symmetric bilateral lesions during kinase inhibitor therapy favor drug effect.
Bacterial paronychia is painful, fluctuant and purulent rather than a dry exophytic vascular nodule.

ddx.dx: Amelanotic melanoma of the nail unit
ddx.vs: Melanoma is usually solitary, progressive and may destroy the nail, and would need biopsy if the lesion persists after drug adjustment.
These vascular lesions occur in immunosuppressed patients but are usually multifocal beyond the nail folds and require histology (HHV-8 or Warthin-Starry) for distinction.

64003.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中額頭皮膚可見數條大致平行、略帶弧形的紅褐色線狀斑塊，呈鞭打狀（flagellate）排列，在接受 ABVD 化療的病人身上符合 bleomycin 引起的鞭狀皮膚炎。
features: Multiple linear to curvilinear erythematous-brown plaques on the forehead
Roughly parallel whip-like (flagellate) arrangement of streaks
Mildly raised lesions on otherwise intact oily skin without vesicles or ulceration
Focal subtle hyperpigmentation along the streaks
64003.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the forehead shows several linear and curvilinear, mildly raised erythematous to brownish plaques arranged in a roughly parallel, whip-like pattern. The overlying skin is intact without vesicles, erosions, or scale. This is a clinical image and histologic features cannot be assessed. In a patient receiving ABVD chemotherapy for Hodgkin lymphoma, the flagellate pattern is consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate dermatitis.

ddx.vs: Dermatographic wheals fade within an hour and excoriations show linear erosions or crusts, whereas bleomycin streaks persist and evolve to hyperpigmentation.
The clinical appearance is nearly identical, so exposure history (raw shiitake ingestion versus bleomycin) is the discriminator.
Dermatomyositis is accompanied by heliotrope rash, Gottron papules, and proximal muscle weakness with elevated CK.
Lymphoma cutis forms nodules or plaques without a whip-like linear pattern and requires biopsy for demonstration of atypical lymphoid cells.

63875.recognize_zh: 周邊血中許多淋巴球的核呈多葉、三葉草或花朵狀（flower cells），染色質濃縮、細胞質極少且無顆粒，大量出現且形態一致，是 HTLV-1 相關成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的代表性表現。
features: Many medium-sized lymphoid cells with multilobated, clover-leaf or flower-like nuclei
Dense, condensed chromatin with no visible nucleoli
Very scant, pale, agranular cytoplasm
A few small lymphocytes with round nuclei for comparison
Pale-staining red cell background with scattered platelets
63875.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with strikingly lobulated, clover-leaf to flower-shaped nuclei, condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Occasional small round lymphocytes are present. Blasts and granular lymphocytes are not seen. Confirmation requires flow cytometry showing a mature CD4+/CD25+ T-cell population, often with loss of CD7, and positive HTLV-1 serology. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have convoluted cerebriform nuclei with fine grooves rather than discrete petal-like lobes, and patients are HTLV-1-negative with erythroderma.
Neutrophils show abundant pink granular cytoplasm and lobes connected by thin filaments, unlike these agranular cells.
T-PLL cells have prominent nucleoli and cytoplasmic protrusions and are TCL1-positive.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell or other B-cell lymphoma with nuclear irregularity
ddx.vs: Clefted B-cell lymphoma cells show notched rather than multilobated nuclei and express B-cell markers on flow cytometry.

63811.recognize_zh: 大小正常、未變大的紅血球內散布大量纖細小環狀體（ring form），部分紅血球內可見兩個環狀體或雙染色質點，且看不到較成熟的滋養體或裂殖體，符合惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）。
features: Numerous small, delicate intraerythrocytic ring forms with thin cytoplasmic rims and tiny chromatin dots
Infected red cells are normal in size, without enlargement or Schüffner-type stippling
Occasional red cells harbor more than one ring, and some rings show double chromatin dots
No mature trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes in this field
Parasitemia visibly high (multiple infected cells per low-power field); rare crenated red cell as artifact
63811.describe_en: Peripheral blood thin smear shows a monolayer of normocytic red cells, a substantial proportion of which contain small, delicate ring-form trophozoites. Infected erythrocytes are not enlarged and lack stippling; several cells contain multiple rings and some rings display double chromatin dots. Mature trophozoites and schizonts are not seen in this field. The parasite burden appears high and should be quantified on the thin film. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria.

ddx.vs: Infected red cells are enlarged with Schüffner stippling, and ameboid trophozoites and schizonts are commonly present, unlike the normal-sized cells with only rings here.
Babesia rings are pleomorphic, may form extracellular forms and tetrads (Maltese cross), and lack hemozoin pigment and gametocytes; travel/tick history and PCR help.
Show band-form and mature trophozoites and schizonts in circulation; P. knowlesi early rings can mimic falciparum, requiring PCR in appropriate travel settings.

ddx.dx: Platelets or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets lack the ring-shaped cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot and lie in a different focal plane.

63747.recognize_zh: 這是 IGV 基因體檢視畫面，位置在第 3 號染色體 MYD88 基因（chr3:38,182,641 附近）；灰色讀序中同一欄位有一部分顯示 C（T>C），對應下方胺基酸 L（白胺酸），代表 MYD88 L265P 突變，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的分子標記。
features: Integrative Genomics Viewer screenshot of aligned NGS reads, chr3:38,182,621-38,182,661 (41 bp window)
MYD88 gene track with reference sequence and amino-acid translation at bottom
Single-position variant: blue 'C' base calls in a subset of reads at the same coordinate (T>C)
Altered codon corresponds to leucine (L) at the site of L265P (p.Leu265Pro; legacy numbering)
Isolated scattered mismatches in other reads (e.g., single T or G) represent sequencing noise
63747.describe_en: Next-generation sequencing of bone marrow aspirate DNA, visualized in the Integrative Genomics Viewer, shows aligned reads across a 41-bp window of MYD88 on chromosome 3p22. A consistent T>C substitution is present in a subset of reads at a single coordinate (reported variant allele frequency approximately 30%), altering the leucine codon to proline and corresponding to MYD88 L265P. Isolated single-read mismatches elsewhere represent background sequencing noise. MYD88 L265P is present in more than 90% of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia and supports that diagnosis in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context, although it is not entirely specific.

ddx.vs: MYD88 L265P occurs in only a minority (<10%) of MZL, so a positive result favors LPL but does not exclude MZL.
IgM MGUS also frequently harbors MYD88 L265P, so marrow infiltrate burden and paraprotein level are needed to separate it from LPL.

ddx.dx: Activated B-cell type DLBCL (e.g., primary CNS, testicular)
ddx.vs: ABC-DLBCL can carry MYD88 L265P but is morphologically a large-cell lymphoma, often with CD79B mutations.

63683.recognize_zh: 這是透過目鏡拍攝的照片，圓形視野中布滿成片、大小一致的小型成熟淋巴球（核圓、染色質濃密、細胞質極少），偶見較大、細胞質較多的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes），符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）骨髓浸潤。
features: Sheets of small, uniform mature lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered slightly larger cells with more cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes
Markedly reduced normal hematopoietic elements; occasional band/segmented neutrophils
Interspersed fat vacuoles within the cellular smear
Photograph taken through the eyepiece with limited resolution; nuclear detail and nucleoli cannot be assessed
63683.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate/imprint smear, photographed through the microscope eyepiece, shows a hypercellular preparation composed predominantly of sheets of small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, condensed nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Occasional larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes, are interspersed, and residual granulocytic elements are sparse. The image resolution does not permit evaluation of chromatin pattern or nucleoli, and smudge cells cannot be assessed. In conjunction with flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim surface light chain), findings are consistent with involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often slightly larger with irregular nuclear contours and are CD23 negative/cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, which requires immunophenotyping to separate.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic transformation / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes exceeding about 15% of lymphoid cells (larger cells with a prominent central nucleolus) indicate progression, whereas here they are only occasional.
These show plasmacytoid or villous cells and are typically CD5 and CD23 negative on flow cytometry.
Hematogones have homogeneous fine chromatin and a maturing polyclonal B-cell pattern on flow cytometry, without monotypic light chain restriction.

63619.recognize_zh: 活體染色（brilliant cresyl blue）下，許多紅血球內佈滿均勻細小的藍色點狀沉澱，整顆細胞看起來像高爾夫球表面（golf ball inclusions），這是 HbH（β4 四聚體）沉澱，與網狀紅血球的粗網狀或少數顆粒不同。
features: Supravital preparation with red cells stained pale blue-green
Many red cells contain numerous fine, evenly distributed dark blue dots giving a golf ball or pitted appearance (HbH inclusions)
Inclusions are uniform in size and spread throughout the entire cell
Occasional cells with coarse clumped or reticular material consistent with reticulocytes
Remaining red cells lack inclusions
63619.describe_en: Supravital brilliant cresyl blue preparation of peripheral blood shows many red cells containing numerous fine, evenly distributed blue-staining inclusions that impart a golf ball appearance. Occasional cells contain coarser clumped reticular material consistent with reticulocytes, and other red cells lack inclusions. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin H inclusions (precipitated beta-globin tetramers), supporting a diagnosis of hemoglobin H disease.

ddx.vs: Reticulocytes contain an irregular filamentous or coarse granular network of RNA rather than evenly spaced fine dots covering the whole cell.
Heinz bodies are one to few larger, round, often membrane-attached inclusions, typically seen with crystal violet in G6PD deficiency or unstable hemoglobins.
Pappenheimer bodies are a few peripheral clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, not diffuse fine stippling.

63555.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一顆細胞質塞滿數個淡粉紅透亮圓球的漿細胞（Mott cell），旁邊還有一顆遠大於細胞的均質粉紅色球體（細胞外 Russell body），周圍多顆核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀的漿細胞。
features: Mott cell with cytoplasm distended by multiple round, pale eosinophilic, refractile globules (Russell bodies)
Large solitary homogeneous eosinophilic globule several times the size of a cell, lying free with a retraction space
Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse cartwheel chromatin and amphophilic cytoplasm, some enlarged with a visible nucleolus
Admixed eosinophilic granulocytes/myelocytes with bright red granules and occasional neutrophils
Interstitial location between adipocytes in a marrow trephine
63555.describe_en: High-power H&E section of bone marrow trephine shows an interstitial population of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped cartwheel chromatin and amphophilic cytoplasm, several of which are enlarged with small nucleoli. A Mott cell containing multiple round, pale eosinophilic Russell bodies is present, and a large extracellular homogeneous eosinophilic globule lies nearby. Eosinophilic granulocytes and other myeloid precursors are admixed. Findings demonstrate plasma cells with Mott cell and Russell body formation; the degree of plasmacytosis and clonality should be assessed with CD138 and kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry to distinguish reactive plasmacytosis from plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Eosinophil precursors contain numerous small coarse refractile orange-red granules rather than a few large smooth spherical globules.
Signet ring cells contain a single large mucin vacuole compressing a crescentic atypical nucleus and are keratin positive, unlike plasma cells with multiple eosinophilic immunoglobulin globules.
Hemophagocytosed red cells are uniform in size and biconcave with a histiocytic nucleus, whereas Russell bodies vary in size within a plasma cell with clock-face chromatin.

63491.recognize_zh: H&E 骨髓切片下半部是密集、深染的小至中型母細胞樣圓形細胞，上方則是淡粉紅、細胞輪廓模糊、核淡化或消失的區域，存活腫瘤細胞與壞死區交界清楚，符合急性白血病合併局部凝固性壞死。
features: Sheets of monotonous small to intermediate round cells with high N:C ratio and hyperchromatic nuclei
Adjacent pale eosinophilic zone with ghost-like cell outlines and loss or fading of nuclear staining
Granular eosinophilic amorphous debris within the necrotic area
Loss of normal trilineage hematopoiesis and fat in the viable areas
Fragmented, loosely cohesive tissue
63491.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow effaced by sheets of monotonous small to intermediate cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and dark nuclei. Adjacent to the viable infiltrate there is a pale eosinophilic area in which cell outlines are preserved as ghosts while nuclear staining is faded or lost, with eosinophilic granular debris. Normal hematopoietic elements are not evident. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with focal coagulative (bone marrow) necrosis; lineage assignment requires immunophenotyping of viable areas.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor with necrosis
ddx.vs: Tumor cells would form cohesive nests or rosettes and be keratin, synaptophysin, or other non-hematopoietic marker positive, and negative for CD45/TdT/CD34.
Artifact produces smeared, streaming nuclear chromatin rather than ghost cells with preserved outlines and eosinophilic necrotic debris.

ddx.dx: Bone marrow necrosis secondary to sickle cell crisis or sepsis
ddx.vs: In non-neoplastic necrosis the viable marrow shows normal trilineage hematopoiesis rather than a monotonous blast infiltrate.
Also necrosis-prone but shows intermediate cells with starry-sky tingible-body macrophages, CD10+/BCL6+, TdT negative, and a Ki-67 near 100% with MYC rearrangement.

63299.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，骨小樑旁的造血組織內散布大量細胞質鮮紅色、呈顆粒狀的嗜酸性球系細胞，並可見數個巨核細胞，細胞密度偏高；這種骨髓嗜酸性球增生本身不具特異性，需配合流式的異常 T 細胞才能歸為淋巴球型 HES。
features: Bone marrow core with a bony trabecula and increased cellularity for age, interspersed with fat
Numerous cells with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm (eosinophils and precursors) scattered throughout
Megakaryocytes present, scattered, without obvious clustering at this power
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with focal interstitial hemorrhage
No discrete lymphoid aggregates or sheets of blasts seen at this magnification
63299.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-intermediate power shows a hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula, with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis. There is a conspicuous increase in eosinophilic granulocytes with bright granular cytoplasm distributed throughout the interstitium. Megakaryocytes are present without evident atypical clustering, and no lymphoid aggregates or sheets of blasts are identified at this magnification. The marrow eosinophilia is nonspecific; together with the aberrant T-cell population detected by flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Shows similar eosinophilic hyperplasia but often with loose spindled CD25+ mast cells and reticulin fibrosis; confirmation is by FIP1L1-PDGFRA testing.
Features compact aggregates of spindled tryptase/CD117-positive mast cells with KIT D816V, which are not evident here and need tryptase immunostaining to exclude.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: These cause secondary eosinophilia but show infiltrates of Reed-Sternberg cells or atypical lymphoid aggregates, which are absent in this field.

63235.recognize_zh: 低倍切片中有多個小型萎縮濾泡，中央是淡粉紅色玻璃樣化的生發中心，外圍小淋巴球一圈圈同心圓排列形成洋蔥皮樣（onion-skin）套膜區，濾泡間富含血管；這是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型低倍表現。
features: Multiple small atretic follicles scattered in a diffuse lymphoid background
Regressed germinal centers that are pale and eosinophilic with hyalinized material
Expanded mantle zones with concentric onion-skin layering of small lymphocytes
Prominent interfollicular vascularity with small vessels
No sinuses or sheets of large atypical cells evident at this low magnification
63235.describe_en: Low-power section of a lymphoid lesion shows multiple small atretic follicles with pale, hyalinized, regressed germinal centers surrounded by well-developed mantle zones arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The interfollicular areas are vascular and populated by small lymphocytes, and no sheets of atypical large cells are identified. Cellular detail such as plasma cell content and twinning of germinal centers cannot be evaluated at this power. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: May show similar regressed follicles but typically has sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and, if HHV-8-related, LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones, with systemic symptoms.
Neoplastic follicles are crowded, back-to-back and lack mantle zones and polarization, without hyalinized centers or onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Expanded mantles can surround naked germinal centers, but the cells are monotonous, cyclin D1-positive and CD5-positive.
Shows follicle involution with vascular proliferation, but occurs with HIV infection and marked lymphocyte depletion rather than expanded onion-skin mantles.

63107.recognize_zh: CD34 染色中，右側充滿血液的腔隙之間的間隔與周邊脾臟組織中的小血管呈陽性，但大型血管腔的內襯細胞本身大致為陰性；littoral cell angioma 的內襯細胞典型為 CD34 陰性。
features: IHC for CD34 on spleen, low power
Strong staining of vessels within septa and around large blood-filled channels (right)
Scattered small CD34+ capillaries in adjacent splenic parenchyma (left)
Lining cells of the large blood-filled spaces appear largely CD34-negative
Blood-filled lumina with background red cells
63107.describe_en: CD34 immunostain of spleen highlights capillaries in the adjacent parenchyma and vessels within the fibrous septa between large blood-filled channels. The cells lining the large blood-filled channels of the lesion appear largely negative at this magnification, although distinguishing septal vessels from the lining layer is limited at low power. A CD34-negative lining, in conjunction with CD31, CD68/CD163, and CD21 positivity, supports the diagnosis of littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma channels are lined by CD34-positive endothelium and lack histiocytic markers (CD68, CD163).
SANT nodules contain a mixture of CD34+ capillaries and CD8+ sinusoids within fibrotic nodules.
Angiosarcoma shows cytologic atypia and invasive growth with variable CD34 but consistent CD31/ERG positivity.

63043.recognize_zh: A 圖血清蛋白電泳病人道有兩條異常帶（星號），B 圖免疫固定電泳在 IgG（γ）道出現對應帶（箭頭），但 kappa 與 lambda 道皆無相對應帶，代表只有游離 γ 重鏈；C–E 組織為成片漿細胞樣淋巴球／漿細胞，G、H 輕鏈免疫染色陰性，符合 γ 重鏈病。
features: Panel A: serum protein electrophoresis with two abnormal bands (asterisks) in the patient lane compared with control
Panel B: immunofixation showing bands in the IgG (gamma) lane (arrowheads) without corresponding kappa or lambda bands
Panels C-E (H&E): diffuse sheets of small to medium lymphoplasmacytic cells and plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate cytoplasm
Panels F and I: immunostains with diffuse positivity in the infiltrate (markers not labeled)
Panels G and H: kappa and lambda light-chain stains essentially negative apart from rare cells
63043.describe_en: Composite figure combining protein studies and histology. Serum protein electrophoresis shows two abnormal bands, and immunofixation localizes them to the IgG heavy-chain lane with no matching kappa or lambda light-chain bands, indicating a free gamma heavy chain. Tissue sections show diffuse sheets of lymphoplasmacytic cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, and immunostains show diffuse positivity for markers in panels F and I with absence of kappa and lambda light-chain expression. Findings are consistent with gamma heavy chain disease, here arising in a patient with systemic lupus erythematosus.

ddx.dx: IgG plasma cell myeloma or plasmacytoma
ddx.vs: Myeloma produces an intact IgG with a matching kappa or lambda band on immunofixation and light-chain-restricted plasma cells, whereas heavy chain disease lacks light chains.
LPL usually secretes intact IgM with light-chain restriction and MYD88 L265P, not a free gamma chain without light chains.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with both kappa and lambda positive cells and polyclonal gammopathy, unlike light-chain-negative sheets with a discrete band.
Alpha HCD involves IgA heavy chain in intestinal mucosa, identified in the IgA lane rather than the IgG lane.

62851.recognize_zh: 成群的中大型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等，部分芽細胞核中有淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核，cup-shaped nuclei），旁邊有一顆分葉核中性球作對照，是 NPM1 突變 AML 的形態線索。
features: Clusters of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Some blasts show a pale nuclear invagination (cup-like indentation)
Scant to moderate agranular pale blue-gray cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
A single segmented neutrophil and a disrupted larger cell nearby; red cells in background
62851.describe_en: The smear shows clusters of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant to moderate agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts show a pale nuclear invagination giving a cup-shaped (fish-mouth) appearance, although the feature is less conspicuous in this field than in classic examples. Auer rods are not identified, and a single mature segmented neutrophil is present for comparison. In the clinical setting of marked leukocytosis with 85-88% blasts, findings are suggestive of AML with cup-like blast morphology, confirmed as AML with mutated NPM1 and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei, faint granules and occasional Auer rod bundles, and is confirmed by PML::RARA.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO-negative and express B- or T-lymphoid markers on flow cytometry.

62787.recognize_zh: 這是VHL基因exon 3的Sanger定序圖：上方野生型在標示位置為單一C峰（藍），下方病人同一位置只有單一T峰（紅），沒有重疊雙峰，代表同型合子c.598C>T（Chuvash polycythemia）。
features: Two Sanger sequencing electropherograms of VHL exon 3 aligned over the same sequence context (TGTGCAGAAAGACCTGGAG-x-GGCTGACACAGGAGCGCATTG)
Top trace (wild type): single blue C peak at the highlighted position
Bottom trace (patient): single red T peak at the same position, without an underlying C peak
Absence of overlapping double peaks indicates homozygosity rather than heterozygosity
Good-quality traces with evenly spaced, non-overlapping peaks flanking the variant
62787.describe_en: Sanger sequencing electropherograms of VHL exon 3 are shown with a wild-type reference (top) and the patient sample (bottom). At the highlighted position, the reference shows a single C peak, whereas the patient trace shows a single T peak without a superimposed C signal. Flanking sequence and peak quality are good. Findings are consistent with a homozygous VHL c.598C>T (p.Arg200Trp) substitution, the characteristic Chuvash polycythemia variant.

ddx.vs: A heterozygote shows overlapping C and T peaks of roughly equal height at the variant position rather than a clean single T peak.
A primer-site polymorphism can make a heterozygote appear homozygous; parental testing or an alternative primer set resolves this.
Compound heterozygotes show a heterozygous c.598C>T with a second distinct VHL variant elsewhere, not a homozygous single-peak change.

62723.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量中大型不成熟細胞，細胞核呈雙葉或蝴蝶狀（bilobed nucleus），細胞質淡藍、顆粒稀少細小，這種「核雙葉、顆粒少」的組合是微顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL, hypogranular variant）的典型外觀。
features: Marked leukocytosis with numerous medium to large abnormal promyelocytes
Bilobed, 'butterfly' or reniform nuclei with deep central clefts
Moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm with sparse fine granules (hypogranular)
Fine chromatin; Auer rods not clearly visible at this magnification
Background red cells with crenation and small red cell clumps; platelets decreased
62723.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of medium to large abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed, butterfly-shaped or deeply clefted nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of pale basophilic cytoplasm with sparse fine granules. Auer rods are not definitively identified at this magnification. Platelets are decreased, and small red cell aggregates are present. Findings are consistent with the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML-RARA and coagulation studies for DIC are required.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have folded nuclei but greyer cytoplasm, are strongly NSE positive and HLA-DR/CD14/CD64 positive, whereas microgranular APL is strongly MPO positive and HLA-DR negative.
Cup-like blasts show a single pale nuclear invagination in a round nucleus rather than bilobed nuclei, and are PML-RARA negative.
Classic APL has cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells), usually with lower WBC.

ddx.dx: Sézary cells or other lymphoid cells with cerebriform nuclei
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells lack cytoplasmic granules and MPO and are smaller with condensed chromatin.

62659.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交中，一群大型細胞的細胞核呈深藍紫色陽性訊號，周圍組織為淡粉紅色對比染色且陰性；表示腫瘤細胞帶有 EB 病毒，常見於與 HHV8 共感染的原發性滲出性淋巴瘤。
features: Cluster of large cells with dark blue-purple nuclear EBER signal
Signal intensity varies from strong to weak among tumor nuclei
Some nuclei in the cluster are negative, showing only pink counterstain
Signal confined to nuclei, no cytoplasmic or background staining
Surrounding stroma negative; morphology of cells poorly preserved on this preparation
62659.describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization with chromogenic (blue-purple) detection shows a cluster of large cells with nuclear EBER signal of variable intensity, while the surrounding stroma and some nuclei in the cluster are negative with pink counterstain. Cytologic detail is limited on this preparation. Findings indicate EBV infection of the neoplastic cells, which is common in primary effusion lymphoma arising in HIV-positive patients and supports the diagnosis in combination with HHV8 positivity.

ddx.vs: Frequently EBER-positive with similar plasmablastic phenotype, but HHV8 (LANA-1) is negative.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBER-positive but usually retains CD20/PAX5 and is HHV8-negative.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8-positive but characteristically EBER-negative, whereas PEL is often EBV co-infected.

62467.recognize_zh: A 為巨大多核細胞，約十餘個大小一致、彼此分開的圓到橢圓形核，細胞質豐富呈淡紫色細顆粒狀，是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）；B 為橢圓形單核細胞，核偏位，細胞質偏藍且淡染區（hof）離核較遠，呈彗星狀，是造骨細胞（osteoblast），見於嬰兒惡性骨質石化症骨髓抹片。
features: Panel A: very large multinucleated cell with about a dozen separate, uniform round-to-oval nuclei, each with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Panel A: abundant pale purple, finely granular cytoplasm with irregular, ragged borders
Panel B: medium-large oval cell with an eccentric round nucleus displaced to one pole (comet-like shape)
Panel B: moderately basophilic, slightly granular cytoplasm with a pale zone located away from the nucleus
Background of red cells with few hematopoietic cells, a neutrophil adjacent to the osteoblast
62467.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate smears. Panel A shows a very large multinucleated cell containing numerous discrete, uniform round-to-oval nuclei within abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm, consistent with an osteoclast. Panel B shows an oval mononuclear cell with an eccentric nucleus, basophilic cytoplasm, and a pale zone separated from the nucleus, consistent with an osteoblast, adjacent to a segmented neutrophil. The surrounding smear is relatively paucicellular. Findings demonstrate osteoclasts and osteoblasts in the marrow aspirate, which in an infant with the appropriate radiographic findings is compatible with infantile malignant osteopetrosis.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated, overlapping nucleus rather than many separate uniform nuclei.
Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof immediately adjacent to the nucleus, whereas the osteoblast pale zone lies away from the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated giant cell / tumor giant cell (e.g., Langhans or metastatic tumor)
ddx.vs: Tumor giant cells show pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei and inflammatory giant cells occur in granulomas, whereas osteoclast nuclei are uniform and bland.
Histiocytes are mononuclear with vacuolated cytoplasm containing ingested cells rather than multiple nuclei.

62403.recognize_zh: 高倍下右上方腺上皮內有一團小淋巴細胞聚集侵入並破壞上皮，形成淋巴上皮病灶（lymphoepithelial lesion），固有層則充滿小至中型、核稍不規則、細胞質淡染的中心細胞樣/單核球樣 B 細胞與漿細胞；這是黏膜相關淋巴組織淋巴瘤（MALT lymphoma）的典型所見。
features: Cluster of lymphoid cells infiltrating and distorting glandular epithelium (lymphoepithelial lesion)
Lamina propria expanded by small to intermediate centrocyte-like cells with slightly irregular nuclei
Cells with moderate pale to clear cytoplasm (monocytoid appearance)
Admixed plasma cells with eccentric nuclei
Tall columnar glandular epithelium with preserved goblet-like cells
62403.describe_en: High-power view of mucosa shows a glandular structure whose epithelium is infiltrated by a cohesive aggregate of lymphoid cells, forming a lymphoepithelial lesion. The adjacent lamina propria is expanded by small to intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with plasma cells. Large transformed cells are not prominent in this field. The findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma), with confirmation by immunophenotyping and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates may show scattered intraepithelial lymphocytes but not destructive aggregates, and the B cells are polyclonal without CD43 co-expression.
MCL cells are monotonous with scant cytoplasm, lack plasma cell differentiation and lymphoepithelial lesions, and are cyclin D1-positive.
DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli rather than small centrocyte-like cells.

62339.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片中，棘狀增生的鱗狀上皮之間的真皮乳頭內塞滿了片狀、不黏聚的漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞，核偏位、大小不一並可見明顯核仁與多核細胞，提示骨髓瘤皮膚侵犯。
features: Dense dermal nodules of discohesive plasmacytoid cells filling expanded dermal papillae
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli and marked size variation
Scattered binucleated and multinucleated giant tumor cells
Loose edematous stroma with thin-walled vessels surrounding tumor aggregates
Overlying acanthotic squamous epithelium without dysplasia; tumor cells do not arise from the epidermis
62339.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows acanthotic but cytologically unremarkable squamous epithelium overlying dermal papillae that are expanded by dense aggregates of discohesive plasmacytoid cells. The tumor cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin, variably prominent nucleoli and marked pleomorphism, with scattered binucleated and multinucleated forms, set in a loose edematous vascular stroma. There is no continuity with or dysplasia of the epidermis. The findings are suggestive of cutaneous involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm, to be confirmed with CD138, MUM1 and kappa/lambda immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma has scant cytoplasm, finely granular salt-and-pepper chromatin and CK20 dot-like/neuroendocrine positivity, not abundant eccentric plasmacytoid cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL leg type is CD20/BCL2/MUM1-positive centroblast-immunoblast sheets, whereas myeloma cells are CD20-negative, CD138-positive with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction.
Melanoma can be discohesive with prominent nucleoli and plasmacytoid shape but expresses S100/SOX10/Melan-A and may show junctional component or pigment.
Reactive infiltrates contain small mature polytypic plasma cells mixed with lymphocytes, lacking the pleomorphic nucleolated and multinucleated cells seen here.

62275.recognize_zh: CD20 染色可見一個巨大、形狀不規則的 B 細胞結節佔據大部分視野，內部深淺斑駁，左下與右上另有小而完整的 CD20 陽性濾泡作為對照，符合 PTGC。
features: Large, irregular CD20-positive B-cell nodule occupying most of the field
Heterogeneous staining with denser rims and lighter internal zones reflecting admixed mantle cells and germinal center remnants
Several small, round, normal-sized CD20-positive follicles at the lower left and upper/lower right
CD20-negative interfollicular T-zone surrounding the nodule
Fibrous capsule with vessels at the right edge; cleft artifacts present
62275.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows a large, irregularly shaped B-cell nodule with heterogeneous staining intensity, in which dense collections of small CD20-positive B cells alternate with lighter zones. Several small, normal-sized follicles are present nearby, and the interfollicular areas are largely CD20-negative, preserving nodal compartmentalization. Findings support an expanded B-cell nodule consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers, in correlation with IgD and CD10 staining.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules contain scattered large CD20+ LP cells rimmed by PD-1+ T cells and usually replace most of the node, whereas PTGC is a focal nodule among reactive follicles without LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma shows diffuse crowding of similar-sized neoplastic follicles with CD10/BCL2 co-expression rather than a single giant nodule adjacent to small reactive follicles.

62211.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中紅血球母細胞（erythroblast）成群聚集，部分細胞呈雙核或核分葉、核碎裂狀，配合先天性貧血病史才會想到先天性紅血球生成不良性貧血（CDA）；本圖解析度偏低，多核型態無法完全確認。
features: Clusters of erythroid precursors with dense, dark round nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm
Occasional erythroblasts with two nuclear profiles or lobulated/fragmented nuclei suggestive of binuclearity and karyorrhexis
Erythroid precursors dominate the cellular clusters compared with granulocytic cells
Scattered larger mononuclear cells and a stromal/macrophage-like cell with an oval nucleus in the center
Background red cells without obvious blasts; image is low resolution and slightly blurred
62211.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of erythroid precursors that predominate among the nucleated cells. Several erythroblasts show irregular, lobulated or paired nuclear profiles suggesting binuclearity and nuclear fragmentation, with some nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Granulocytic precursors are present without increased blasts. Image resolution limits confident assessment of multinuclearity and internuclear chromatin bridges. Findings are compatible with dyserythropoiesis and, in the appropriate congenital clinical setting, suggestive of congenital dyserythropoietic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS is acquired, usually in older adults, and shows multilineage dysplasia, increased blasts or ring sideroblasts and clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities rather than isolated lifelong dyserythropoiesis.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts are large with open, sieve-like chromatin and are accompanied by giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, correcting with B12/folate.
PEL shows sheets of proerythroblasts (≥30%) with >80% erythroid cells and marked atypia, not a maturing erythroid series with binucleate forms.
These show microcytosis, target cells and abnormal hemoglobin studies, whereas CDA II shows prominent binucleate late erythroblasts (HEMPAS, SEC23B) and CDA I shows internuclear chromatin bridges.

62147.recognize_zh: 多格組合圖：骨髓切片細胞密度高、由單一形態細胞取代，周邊血可見母細胞，流式細胞圖呈母細胞族群，核型圖箭頭指出第 4 與第 12 號染色體異常，FISH 顯示分離訊號，提示復發 NPM1 突變 AML 合併 PDGFRA 重組。
features: Hypercellular marrow biopsy with sheets of monotonous immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis (A)
Peripheral blood with scattered blasts with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm (B)
Flow cytometry dot plots showing a dominant immature myeloid population (C)
Karyotype with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes 4 and 12, suggesting a 4q12-involving rearrangement (D)
Metaphase FISH with split/translocated signals supporting PDGFRA rearrangement (E, F)
62147.describe_en: This composite figure shows a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with sheets of immature mononuclear cells (A) and circulating blasts in the peripheral blood (B). Flow cytometry dot plots (C) display a predominant immature myeloid population; the axis labels are too small to read reliably at this resolution. The karyotype (D) shows arrows at chromosomes 4 and 12, and metaphase FISH studies (E, F) show separated fusion probe signals, supporting a PDGFRA rearrangement. In the context of a relapsed NPM1-mutated AML, these findings suggest acquisition of a PDGFRA rearrangement at relapse; exact immunophenotype and breakpoints cannot be read from this image.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: This entity typically presents as a chronic eosinophilic myeloproliferative process with FIP1L1::PDGFRA (cryptic 4q12 deletion) rather than an NPM1-mutated AML with a high blast count.
AML-MR is defined by MDS-related cytogenetics or mutations, whereas an NPM1 mutation takes precedence in classification.
A new clone after prior chemotherapy may represent a therapy-related neoplasm; persistence of the original NPM1 mutation favors clonal evolution of the relapsed AML.

62147.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; flow cytometry; karyotype; FISH

62083.recognize_zh: 非形態學圖：左為毛細管電泳，HbA 69.2%、HbS 26.3%、HbA2 2.2%；右為 CBC，MCV 72.7 fL、MCH 22.9 pg 小球性低色素且 RBC 數偏高，HbS 比例低於一般特徵（約 35–40%），提示鐮刀型血球特質合併 α 型地中海貧血。
features: Capillary zone electrophoresis with a dominant HbA peak and a second large HbS peak (A)
Fraction table: HbA 69.2%, HbF 1.9%, HbS 26.3%, HbA2 2.2%, Z1 zone 0.4%
Normal HbA2 (2.2%), arguing against coexisting beta-thalassemia trait
CBC with RBC 5.06 x10^6/uL, Hb 11.6 g/dL, MCV 72.7 fL, MCH 22.9 pg, RDW-CV 18.8% (B)
Platelets 494 x10^3/uL with analyzer flags for anisocytosis, microcytosis, NRBC and thrombocytosis
62083.describe_en: This figure is non-morphologic. Capillary hemoglobin zone electrophoresis (A) shows HbA 69.2%, HbS 26.3%, HbF 1.9% and HbA2 2.2%, and the automated CBC (B) shows mild microcytic hypochromic anemia with a relatively high red cell count (5.06 x10^6/uL), MCV 72.7 fL, MCH 22.9 pg, raised RDW and thrombocytosis. The presence of HbA exceeding HbS indicates sickle cell trait rather than sickle cell disease. An HbS fraction below the usual 35–40% range for trait, combined with microcytosis and normal HbA2, is consistent with coinherited alpha thalassemia; iron deficiency should be excluded and alpha-globin gene testing can confirm.

ddx.vs: HbS/beta+ thalassemia shows HbS greater than HbA with elevated HbA2 above 3.5%, whereas here HbA exceeds HbS with normal HbA2.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell trait with iron deficiency
ddx.vs: Iron deficiency also lowers the HbS fraction and MCV, but ferritin is low and the red cell count is usually reduced rather than preserved.
Uncomplicated trait has normal MCV and HbS typically 35–40%, unlike the microcytosis and 26% HbS here.
HbS/beta0 thalassemia has no HbA, with HbS predominance and raised HbA2, clearly different from this pattern.

62019.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色中，多顆紅血球系前驅細胞的細胞核周圍被藍色粗鐵顆粒環繞（至少 5 顆、環繞核周 1/3 以上），即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；這是 MDS-RS 的診斷性發現。
features: Multiple erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules encircling the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Granules number ≥5 and cover at least one third of the nuclear circumference in several cells
Other erythroid precursors show fewer, scattered granules
Myeloid precursors and larger cells lack siderotic granules
Occasional extracellular/macrophage iron in background; nuclear fast red counterstain
62019.describe_en: Prussian blue iron stain of the bone marrow aspirate shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring, fulfilling criteria for ring sideroblasts (≥5 granules encircling at least one third of the nucleus). Other erythroid precursors contain scattered granules, and stainable storage iron is present. Ring sideroblasts should be enumerated as a percentage of erythroid precursors (≥15%, or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation). The findings are consistent with MDS with ring sideroblasts in the context of multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Congenital forms present in youth, often microcytic, without granulocytic or megakaryocytic dysplasia.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency, zinc excess)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are identical; exposure history, copper/zinc levels and resolution after correction exclude MDS.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Iron stain is identical; platelet count ≥450 x10^9/L with large MPN-like megakaryocytes defines MDS/MPN-RS-T.
Normal sideroblasts have few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.

61955.recognize_zh: 高倍下是大型多形性細胞成片，核形不規則、部分呈腎形或馬蹄形（hallmark cell 樣），細胞質豐富且呈泡沫空泡狀，間雜嗜酸性球與凋亡碎片，符合ALK陰性ALCL。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale, finely vacuolated to foamy cytoplasm
Irregular, indented, kidney-shaped to horseshoe-like nuclei with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Occasional multinucleated or wreath-like nuclei
Scattered eosinophils, small lymphocytes and apoptotic debris in the background
Cohesive growth without a nested epithelial pattern
61955.describe_en: High-power H&E shows sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular, indented to kidney-shaped nuclei with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, including forms resembling hallmark cells. Scattered eosinophils, small lymphocytes and apoptotic bodies are admixed. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; with uniform strong CD30 expression and absent ALK, this supports ALK-negative ALCL.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; ALK-positive ALCL shows ALK protein by IHC (usually nuclear and cytoplasmic with NPM1::ALK) and typically occurs in younger patients.
HRS cells are scattered in a mixed background and are CD15+/weak PAX5+, while ALCL forms sheets and is PAX5-negative with cytotoxic markers.
PTCL NOS lacks the uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells of ALCL; CD30 is heterogeneous in intensity and distribution.
These are CD30-negative (except embryonal carcinoma) and express keratin or SOX10/S100 respectively.

61891.recognize_zh: 結節狀淋巴濾泡由中等大小、染色質淡的母細胞樣（blastoid）細胞組成，套區不明顯；免疫染色 CD20 與 BCL6 陽性、濾泡內 BCL2 陰性、CD21 顯示濾泡樹突細胞網、Ki-67 極高，符合具兒童型濾泡性淋巴瘤（pediatric-type FL）特徵的濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Expansile nodular/follicular lymphoid infiltrate with attenuated or absent mantle zones (HE&S, low power)
Follicles composed of monotonous medium-sized blastoid cells with open, pale chromatin and scant cytoplasm (x1000)
Diffuse CD20 positivity and nuclear BCL6 positivity within the follicles
BCL2 negative in follicle-center cells, with staining limited to interfollicular small lymphocytes
CD21 highlights a follicular dendritic cell meshwork underlying the nodules
Very high Ki-67 proliferation index within the follicles
61891.describe_en: Composite of a conjunctival biopsy (HE&S and immunohistochemistry). At low power there is an expansile nodular lymphoid infiltrate with follicles showing irregular borders and attenuated mantle zones. At high power the follicles are populated by medium-sized blastoid cells with pale, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells are CD20 and BCL6 positive and BCL2 negative, with a CD21-positive follicular dendritic cell meshwork and a very high Ki-67 index; the unlabeled G panel shows scattered positive cells only. In conjunction with a clonal IGH rearrangement and absent BCL2, BCL6, IRF4 and MYC rearrangements, findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with features of pediatric-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles retain polarization, well-formed mantles and a mixed centroblast/centrocyte population, and lack a clonal IGH rearrangement, whereas this lesion has expansile blastoid follicles and a demonstrable B-cell clone.
Burkitt lymphoma is diffuse without a CD21-positive FDC meshwork and carries a MYC rearrangement, which was absent here.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement
ddx.vs: It shows strong MUM1/IRF4 expression and an IRF4 rearrangement by FISH, whereas these tumor cells were MUM1 negative without IRF4 rearrangement.
Conventional FL usually occurs in older adults with BCL2 protein expression and t(14;18), whereas this follicle-center population is BCL2 negative without BCL2 rearrangement.

61891.stain: HE&S; IHC: CD20, BCL6, BCL2, CD21, Ki-67

61827.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（非形態圖）：第 16 號染色體中一條明顯變長，長臂多出一段帶紋物質，符合 t(1;16) 所形成的衍生 16 號染色體；性染色體為 XX。
features: G-banded karyogram with 46 chromosomes and two X chromosomes (female)
One chromosome 16 homolog markedly elongated with additional banded material on the long arm
Extra material consistent with chromosome 1 derived segments, i.e. der(16)t(1;16)
Chromosome 1 homologs show no obvious reciprocal change at this resolution, suggesting an unbalanced rearrangement
61827.describe_en: The figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. One chromosome 16 homolog is markedly elongated by additional banded material on its long arm, consistent with a derivative chromosome 16 resulting from a t(1;16) translocation, while the chromosome 1 pair shows no obvious reciprocal change at this resolution. Such an unbalanced der(16)t(1;16) results in gain of 1q material, a recurrent secondary abnormality in myeloid neoplasms. In the sister of the GATA2 proband with MDS progressing to AML, this represents an acquired clonal abnormality; FISH or higher-resolution study would define the breakpoints.

61763.recognize_zh: 這張 Cyclin D1 染色中，成片的中型腫瘤細胞核幾乎全為藍色陰性，只有零星散在的細胞（內皮細胞或組織球等內在對照）呈棕色陽性；表示此腫瘤 Cyclin D1 陰性，需以 SOX11 或 CCND2 重組支持被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Sheets of medium-sized tumor cells with round to irregular nuclei, negative for nuclear cyclin D1
Only rare scattered cells show brown staining, serving as internal positive controls
Some positive signals are cytoplasmic/granular, compatible with histiocytes or endothelial cells
Finely dispersed chromatin on hematoxylin counterstain, compatible with blastoid morphology
61763.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for cyclin D1 shows that the diffuse population of medium-sized tumor cells lacks nuclear staining, while rare scattered non-neoplastic cells are positive, indicating adequate staining. The image therefore does not demonstrate the cyclin D1 overexpression expected in most mantle cell lymphomas.
