A cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphoma is still possible and would be supported by SOX11 positivity (as in the companion image) and CCND2 rearrangement; otherwise alternative blastoid B-cell neoplasms should be excluded.

ddx.vs: This variant is SOX11-positive and often carries CCND2 rearrangement despite lacking cyclin D1 protein.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are SOX11-negative and may show MYC/BCL2 rearrangements, whereas MCL is SOX11-positive.
B-ALL is TdT-positive and may express SOX11, so TdT and surface immunoglobulin separate it from MCL.

61699.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（singlets gate）：絕大多數事件落在 CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性象限（81.08%），CD19+ 細胞極少，符合骨髓瘤漿細胞常見的異常表現型（CD19−/CD56+）。
features: Dot plot: CD19 ECD (x-axis) versus CD56 APC700 (y-axis), gated on singlets
Dominant population in the CD19-negative/CD56-positive quadrant (81.08%)
CD19-negative/CD56-negative events 18.42%
Virtually no CD19-positive events (CD19+CD56+ 0.29%, CD19+CD56- 0.20%)
Lineage of the CD56+ population is not shown on this plot and requires CD38/CD138 and cytoplasmic kappa/lambda gating
61699.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD19 versus CD56 on the singlet gate shows a dominant population (81.08%) that is CD19-negative and CD56-positive, with only rare CD19-positive events. In the context of a plasma cell neoplasm, loss of CD19 with aberrant CD56 expression is the characteristic neoplastic plasma cell immunophenotype, in contrast to normal plasma cells, which are typically CD19+/CD56-. Plasma cell identity (bright CD38, CD138) and cytoplasmic light-chain restriction are not displayed here and should be confirmed. Findings are supportive of a clonal plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Normal plasma cells are predominantly CD19-positive and CD56-negative with polytypic cytoplasmic light chains, whereas this population is CD19-negative/CD56-positive.
NK cells are also CD19-/CD56+ but are CD45-bright, CD38-dim, CD138-negative and express CD2/CD7/CD16, which requires additional gating to exclude.
Neuroendocrine tumor cells can be CD56+/CD19- but are CD45- and CD38/CD138-negative and express cytokeratin and synaptophysin on IHC.

61635.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個大型非典型單核細胞，核不規則分葉/摺疊、染色質略開放，細胞質灰藍且邊緣不規則；可能為循環中的淋巴瘤細胞，但型態與單核球重疊，需流式或骨髓切片確認。
features: Single large atypical mononuclear cell, about 2-2.5 times a red cell diameter
Irregular, folded to lobulated nucleus with moderately open chromatin and a possible pale nucleolar area
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, slightly ruffled borders and no granules
Adjacent small dense dark round nucleus (likely pyknotic/naked nucleus)
Background red cells with occasional crenated forms; platelets sparse
61635.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large atypical mononuclear cell with an irregular folded to lobulated nucleus, moderately open chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders. A small dense naked nucleus lies nearby, and the background red cells include scattered crenated forms with sparse platelets. The large cell may represent a circulating neoplastic lymphoid cell, but its features overlap with a monocyte and it cannot be classified with certainty on morphology alone. In the clinical context of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, flow cytometry or tissue correlation is needed to confirm circulating lymphoma cells.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have lacy chromatin without nucleoli, gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles, whereas lymphoma cells have more basophilic agranular cytoplasm and distinct nucleoli and are CD20 positive by flow.
Reactive lymphocytes show abundant cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells with basophilia at the periphery, occurring in a heterogeneous spectrum.
Blasts have round nuclei with very fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli, and express CD34/CD117 or TdT.

61571.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑（右側粉紅色）旁的骨髓腔被單調密集的母細胞完全填滿，核圓或有凹痕、染色質細緻、細胞質少，散在多個核分裂像，看不到正常脂肪與三系造血；是急性淋巴母細胞白血病的骨髓取代型態。
features: Packed marrow with complete replacement of intertrabecular space by blasts; bony trabecula at right
Monotonous small-to-medium cells with high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Round to irregular or indented nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous mitotic figures
No fat, megakaryocytes or maturing myeloid/erythroid elements identified
61571.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a 100% cellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is replaced by sheets of monotonous small-to-medium blasts, abutting a bony trabecula on the right. The blasts have scant cytoplasm, round to irregular or indented nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and numerous mitotic figures are present. Fat, megakaryocytes and maturing hematopoietic elements are not identified. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by acute lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage and the BCR::ABL1-like subtype are established by flow cytometry and genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts typically show more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and MPO/CD117 positivity.
Medium cells with multiple nucleoli, squared cytoplasmic borders, starry-sky macrophages and TdT negativity with MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Often form clusters/rosettes and are CD45-negative with lineage markers such as PHOX2B, CD99/NKX2-2 or myogenin; note Ewing and B-ALL can both be CD99+ and TdT is key.

61507.recognize_zh: 軟組織內一片片大型上皮樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，核卵圓、腎形或有摺疊凹陷，染色質開放、核仁小而清楚，其間散佈成熟嗜中性球；這種「看似癌或組織球的大細胞」在已知 AML 病人身上應先想到髓樣肉瘤（單核球分化）。
features: Sheets of large, discohesive-appearing epithelioid cells
Abundant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Oval, reniform, and folded nuclei with open vesicular chromatin
Small distinct nucleoli
Scattered admixed mature neutrophils and occasional small lymphocytes
Thin-walled capillaries with extravasated red cells; no gland formation or keratinization
61507.describe_en: Soft tissue section shows sheets of large epithelioid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. The nuclei are oval, reniform, or folded with open vesicular chromatin and small distinct nucleoli, and scattered mature neutrophils are admixed. Gland formation, keratinization, and melanin pigment are not seen. The morphology is nonspecific, so immunohistochemistry is required; with CD33 positivity and CD34 negativity in a patient with AML with monocytic differentiation, findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells lack reniform nuclei and granulocytic admixture, and are CD20/PAX5 positive and lysozyme/CD33 negative.
Carcinoma shows more cohesive nests and is keratin positive.
Histiocytic sarcoma has similarly abundant cytoplasm but is CD163+ and lacks CD33/CD34/MPO blast markers and AML association.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and is CD30 strongly positive with T-cell markers or ALK.

61443.recognize_zh: 兩個視野中多顆胞質深藍、核質比高的母細胞，胞質內各含一顆被吞噬的完整紅血球（位於透明空泡中，看起來像「甜甜圈」），部分細胞輪廓不規則；在 B 淋巴母細胞白血病中這種母細胞吞噬紅血球的現象罕見，易誤認為組織球或單核球系母細胞。
features: Blasts with intensely basophilic cytoplasm, high N:C ratio, and dense homogeneous nuclei
Several blasts contain a single engulfed intact erythrocyte within a clear vacuole (erythrophagocytosis)
Irregular, angulated cell outlines with cytoplasmic projections in some cells
No granules, Auer rods, or vacuolated cytoplasm apart from the phagocytic vacuoles
Background of normochromic red cells without schistocytes
61443.describe_en: Smear shows numerous leukemic blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, and condensed nuclei, several of which contain a phagocytosed intact erythrocyte within a clear cytoplasmic vacuole. The cells lack granules and Auer rods, and some have irregular cytoplasmic outlines. Erythrophagocytosis by blasts is uncommon and can mimic monocytic, megakaryoblastic, or histiocytic neoplasms. In the setting of a confirmed B-lymphoblastic phenotype, the findings represent erythrophagocytosis by B-lymphoblasts; the specimen source (blood versus marrow) is not specified in the image.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts with erythrophagocytosis are MPO/NSE-positive and express CD14/CD64, not CD19/CD10/TdT.
The phagocytes are mature histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and low N:C ratio, not blasts.
Blasts with cytoplasmic blebs can resemble these but express CD41/CD61 and are TdT/CD19-negative.
An overlying red cell is in a different focal plane and lacks a surrounding clear vacuole within the cytoplasm.

61379.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 染色可見強膜狀陽性的 B 細胞聚集於血竇腔內，排成線狀與分枝狀的血竇內（intrasinusoidal）分佈，這是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤骨髓侵犯的典型樣式；但陽性細胞偏大、核仁明顯，也需考慮血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: CD20 strong membranous staining in B cells clustered within dilated marrow sinusoids
Intrasinusoidal pattern: linear, branching cords of positive cells outlining vascular channels
Positive cells are medium to large with round vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli
CD20-negative background hematopoietic cells and adipocytes between sinusoids
No discrete paratrabecular or nodular aggregate in this field
61379.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD20 shows strongly positive B cells located predominantly within dilated sinusoids, forming linear and branching intravascular cords, with CD20-negative hematopoietic elements in the intervening marrow. The positive cells appear medium to large with vesicular nuclei. An intrasinusoidal B-cell infiltrate is characteristic of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; however, the relatively large cell size in this field also raises intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, which the case history indicates coexisted. Correlation with H&E cytology, Ki-67, CD5, and clinical findings is required.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells are large with prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67 confined to vessel lumina, often CD5 or MUM1 positive, rather than small marginal zone cells.
Shows a diffuse interstitial fried-egg infiltrate with CD20, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positivity rather than predominantly intrasinusoidal cords.
Also intrasinusoidal, but the cells are CD3+ T cells (usually gamma-delta) and CD20 negative.
CLL forms interstitial and nonparatrabecular nodular infiltrates of small CD5+/CD23+ cells rather than a sinusoidal pattern.

61251.recognize_zh: 油鏡下箭頭處一大團黏聚的腫瘤細胞，共享大片淡紫藍色細胞質、界線不清，核大、圓至橢圓、染色質呈點狀顆粒並有小核仁，體積遠大於周圍的顆粒球前驅細胞、紅血球母細胞與淋巴球；這種成團的非造血細胞為轉移性乳癌。
features: Large cohesive syncytial cluster of tumor cells with poorly defined cell borders (arrow)
Large round to oval nuclei, clearly larger than adjacent hematopoietic cells, with coarsely stippled chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale lilac-blue cytoplasm shared across the cluster
Mild anisonucleosis; no mitotic figures clearly identified
Background of normal marrow elements: myelocytes, segmented neutrophils, erythroblasts and small lymphocytes, with fine stain precipitate
61251.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear examined under oil immersion shows a large cohesive syncytial cluster of tumor cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, indistinct borders and large round to oval nuclei with stippled chromatin and small nucleoli. The tumor cells are much larger than the surrounding normal hematopoietic elements, which include maturing granulocytes, erythroblasts and lymphocytes. Glandular structures are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma in the bone marrow, in keeping with the reported breast primary; immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, GATA3, ER) is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have uniform eccentric nuclei with a pale Golgi zone away from the nucleus and fine chromatin, without anisonucleosis.
A single multinucleated cell with many small uniform nuclei within one sharply bordered granular cytoplasm.
Has a single large lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm rather than many separate nuclei.

ddx.dx: Metastatic neuroblastoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Cells are small with scant cytoplasm and nuclear molding, unlike the large cells with abundant cytoplasm here.

61187.recognize_zh: D 圖在周邊血抹片的羽狀邊緣可見一顆巨大、多葉深染核、周邊有血小板狀碎片的巨核細胞；A 圖為核深染、細胞質極少的小型細胞（疑似小巨核細胞或裸核），B 圖為大型藍色細胞質細胞，背景有淚滴細胞與異形紅血球。
features: Panel D: very large cell with a dense multilobated nucleus, surrounding cytoplasm and adjacent budding platelet-like fragments, consistent with a megakaryocyte
Panel C: low-power view of the feathered edge showing the large cell among streaked red cells, with a separate small dark cell (arrow)
Panel A: small cell with a dense hyperchromatic nucleus and scant cytoplasm (arrow), likely a micromegakaryocyte or bare megakaryocyte nucleus
Panel B: large round cell with homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm, lineage not definitively assignable at this resolution
Background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes; platelets are present
61187.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes. At the feathered edge, a large megakaryocyte with a dense multilobated nucleus and adjacent platelet-like cytoplasmic fragments is identified. Additional fields show a small cell with a dense nucleus and scant cytoplasm, likely a micromegakaryocyte or naked megakaryocyte nucleus, and a large cell with deep blue cytoplasm whose lineage cannot be assigned with certainty. Circulating megakaryocytes are unusual and should prompt evaluation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm (particularly primary myelofibrosis), marrow infiltration or marrow stress; the feathered edge should always be scanned for such large cells.

ddx.dx: Circulating tumor cells (e.g., carcinoma or neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells appear in cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and lack platelet budding, whereas megakaryocytes show lobated nuclei and platelet fragments.
Blasts have fine chromatin with nucleoli and a high N:C ratio rather than a mature multilobated, dense nucleus.

ddx.dx: Large atypical lymphocyte or smudged cell
ddx.vs: Smudged cells lack a defined cytoplasmic border and platelet budding and have a single non-lobated nucleus.

61123.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD3 染色下，皮膚真皮浸潤大部分呈棕色陽性，T 細胞數量明顯多於腫瘤 B 細胞，其間夾雜少數淡染、陰性的小結節區（B 細胞或漿細胞區），說明 MALT 淋巴瘤中背景 T 細胞可以佔多數。
features: Scanning magnification of a skin punch biopsy with dense dermal infiltrate
Diffuse, strong CD3 staining across most of the infiltrate
Scattered small rounded CD3-negative/pale nodular areas within the infiltrate
Infiltrate extends into the deep dermis with a CD3-poor zone at the base
Epidermis unstained; individual cytology not assessable at this magnification
61123.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry on a skin biopsy, at scanning magnification, shows a dense dermal infiltrate in which the majority of cells are CD3-positive T cells. Small, rounded, weakly stained or negative nodular areas are interspersed within the infiltrate, and the lower portion of the biopsy contains fewer positive cells. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this power. The abundance of background T cells, outnumbering the CD20-positive B cells, is a recognized pitfall in cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma, where the neoplastic component is largely plasmacytic and CD20 negative and must be shown by light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (e.g., mycosis fungoides, CD4+ small/medium T-cell LPD)
ddx.vs: T-cell lymphoma shows atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and T-cell clonality, whereas here light-chain-restricted plasmacytic B cells define the neoplasm.
Pseudolymphoma has mixed T and B cells with polytypic plasma cells, requiring kappa/lambda ISH to separate from MZL.
Follicle center lymphoma has CD20+ BCL6+ follicular or diffuse B-cell sheets and fewer T cells, without a plasmacytic clonal population.

61059.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球大小差異大，有較大、偏圓的紅血球（多為網狀紅血球），夾雜少數體積小、缺乏中央淡染區的球形紅血球；結合溫型 IgG 抗體病史，符合自體免疫溶血性貧血，但此照片的球形紅血球不算明顯。
features: Anisocytosis with a population of large round red cells, likely reticulocytes/polychromatic macrocytes
Occasional smaller red cells lacking central pallor, suggestive of microspherocytes
No red cell agglutination or fragmented red cells evident
One small lymphocyte and scattered normal-sized platelets
Yellow-green color cast limits assessment of polychromasia
61059.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with many enlarged round red cells and occasional smaller dense cells lacking central pallor, suggestive of spherocytes. No agglutinates, schistocytes or nucleated red cells are seen in this field; platelets appear adequate. The color cast of the photograph limits recognition of polychromasia, and spherocytes are not prominent in this image. In the context of a positive direct antiglobulin test with a warm IgG antibody, findings are consistent with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: HS spherocytes are more uniform and the DAT is negative, with a family history and abnormal EMA-binding test.
Cold agglutinins cause red cell clumping on the smear with C3-only DAT positivity, not isolated spherocytes.
MAHA shows schistocytes and thrombocytopenia, both absent here.

60867.recognize_zh: 組合圖 A 可見大型芽細胞（核質比高、染色質細緻、胞質淡藍無顆粒）與伴隨的發育異常顆粒球（低分葉、胞質低顆粒）；B 流式圖顯示芽細胞群同時有 MPO 等骨髓系標記與 CD19/cCD79a 等 B 系標記的異質表現，屬帶有混合表型的 AML-MRC。
features: Panel A: large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate agranular pale-to-deep blue cytoplasm
Panel A (right): blasts admixed with dysplastic granulocytes showing hypolobated/pseudo-Pelger-like nuclei and hypogranular cytoplasm
Panel B: flow plots of a CD45-dim blast population with color-coded subpopulations (red, blue, green)
Blast subsets show variable myeloid (e.g., MPO, CD117, CD13/CD33) and B-lineage (e.g., CD19, cCD79a) antigen expression with CD34 positivity; axis labels only partly legible at this resolution
Heterogeneous, non-uniform antigen expression across subsets suggesting mixed-lineage phenotype
60867.describe_en: Composite figure: panel A shows bone marrow aspirate smears with increased large blasts having fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm, accompanied by dysplastic granulocytes with hypolobated nuclei and hypogranular cytoplasm. Panel B shows flow cytometry of a CD45-dim blast population comprising color-coded subsets with variable expression of myeloid-associated antigens (including MPO and CD117) and B-lineage antigens (including CD19 and cytoplasmic CD79a), with CD34 expression; several axis labels are illegible at this resolution, limiting precise interpretation. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes showing a mixed myeloid/B-lineage phenotype; per WHO criteria, the presence of myelodysplasia-related features/cytogenetics excludes a diagnosis of mixed-phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: MPAL requires lineage-defining markers in the absence of AML-defining genetic/myelodysplasia-related criteria; documented MDS-related cytogenetics or multilineage dysplasia/history reclassifies the case as AML-MR.
t(8;21) AML also shows CD19/PAX5 and cCD79a expression, but blasts have salmon-colored granules, prominent hofs and long Auer rods and the translocation is detectable.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigens
ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts may express CD13/CD33 but are MPO negative and lack multilineage dysplasia.
Separated by blast count: MDS-IB2 has 10–19% blasts whereas AML-MR requires at least 20%.

60803.recognize_zh: 與旁邊的分葉核中性球相比，淋巴細胞體積略大、核形不規則呈折疊或凹陷、染色質中度凝集，並有中等量藍色胞質；這種有切迹、胞質較多的非典型淋巴球見於 12 號染色體三體 CLL。
features: Lymphoid cell slightly larger than a neutrophil-sized cell with irregular, folded/indented nucleus
Moderately clumped chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of blue cytoplasm with slightly irregular border
Adjacent normal segmented neutrophil for size comparison
Normocytic, normochromic red cells
60803.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical lymphoid cell, comparable in size to the adjacent segmented neutrophil, with an irregular folded nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, no prominent nucleolus and a moderate rim of blue cytoplasm. The accompanying neutrophil and red cells are morphologically unremarkable. With a CLL immunophenotype, this cleaved lymphocyte with increased cytoplasm is compatible with atypical CLL morphology associated with trisomy 12.

ddx.vs: Cleaved nuclei are similar, but cells are cyclin D1+/SOX11+ and usually CD23-negative with t(11;14).
Prolymphocytes are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus, which is absent here.
Have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei and a CD4+ T-cell phenotype rather than a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.

60611.recognize_zh: 骨髓鐵染色（Prussian blue）見紅血球前驅細胞核周圍環繞藍色鐵顆粒，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）；周邊血紅血球大小稍不一、可見數個血小板，搭配臨床血小板增多，符合 MDS/MPN-RS-T。
features: Peripheral blood: mild anisocytosis with some macrocytic and a subset of hypochromic red cells; platelets visible between red cells
Aspirate (Wright-Giemsa): erythroid hyperplasia with erythroid precursors showing irregular nuclear contours and megaloblastoid features; scattered myeloid cells
Iron stain: numerous erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged around the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Image resolution does not allow reliable assessment of megakaryocyte morphology or platelet count
60611.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show mild anisocytosis with scattered hypochromic and larger red cells and visible platelets. The bone marrow aspirate is cellular with erythroid predominance and mild dyserythropoietic changes. Prussian blue iron stain demonstrates numerous ring sideroblasts, with siderotic granules encircling the erythroid nuclei. In the context of persistent thrombocytosis, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (MDS/MPN-RS-T); correlation with platelet count (≥450 × 10^9/L), megakaryocyte morphology on biopsy and SF3B1/JAK2 mutation testing is required.

ddx.vs: MDS-RS has ring sideroblasts without persistent thrombocytosis ≥450 × 10^9/L or MPN-type large megakaryocytes.
ET lacks ring sideroblasts ≥15% and dyserythropoiesis, and has isolated clustered hyperlobated megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-neoplastic sideroblastic anemia (e.g., alcohol, copper deficiency, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Secondary sideroblastic anemia shows no thrombocytosis or clonal mutations and resolves after removing the cause.
Iron overload increases storage iron in macrophages and scattered cytoplasmic granules but does not create perinuclear rings in erythroblasts.

60675.recognize_zh: 四張周邊血嗜中性球的胞質內各有一至兩顆小而圓、邊界清楚、深紫色的包涵體，大小與顏色類似紅血球中的 Howell-Jolly 小體，與分葉核分開，即 Howell-Jolly 樣小體（Howell-Jolly–like bodies）。
features: Mature neutrophils with normal-sized cells and pink-lilac granular cytoplasm
One or two small, round, sharply defined, dense dark-purple cytoplasmic inclusions separate from the nuclear lobes
Inclusions resemble detached nuclear fragments (chromatin-like staining), not granules
Nuclei are band-to-hyposegmented with coarse clumped chromatin
Background red cells and platelets appear unremarkable
60675.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature neutrophils with normal cytoplasmic granulation. Several neutrophils contain one or two small, round, sharply circumscribed, basophilic inclusions within the cytoplasm that stain like nuclear chromatin and are separate from the nuclear lobes. Some nuclei appear band-like or hyposegmented. The red cells and platelets in the field are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly–like bodies in neutrophils, a finding reported with HIV infection, immunosuppressive or cytotoxic therapy (e.g., mycophenolate), and myelodysplasia.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale gray-blue, irregular patches at the cytoplasmic periphery, not dense dark-purple round chromatin-like dots.
Engulfed organisms are usually multiple, uniform cocci/bacilli or yeast with a clear halo, whereas these are single to paired dense nuclear fragments.
A drumstick is attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand, whereas Howell-Jolly–like bodies lie free in the cytoplasm.
Morulae are larger, stippled, mulberry-like clusters of organisms rather than small homogeneous round chromatin bodies.

60739.recognize_zh: 抹片中滿是成熟分葉嗜中性球（類白血病反應），真正的腫瘤細胞稀少而容易漏看；ALK 分離探針 FISH 顯示紅綠訊號分開（重組），免疫染色則標出散在的大型陽性細胞，證實為 ALK 陽性退行性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Aspirate/smear (A): marked predominance of mature segmented and band neutrophils, consistent with a leukemoid reaction; few larger mononuclear cells
FISH (B): ALK break-apart probe with separated 3′ (red) and 5′ (green) signals in the rearranged nucleus versus fused signals in the normal nucleus
IHC (C): scattered large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining, including Golgi-pattern accentuation, among many negative small cells
IHC (D): rare large positive cells with cytoplasmic staining (second marker, unlabeled)
Tumor cells are sparse and would be easily obscured by the neutrophilic background
60739.describe_en: The smear shows an overwhelming population of mature segmented and band neutrophils, representing a marked leukemoid reaction, with only occasional larger mononuclear cells. Interphase FISH with an ALK break-apart probe demonstrates split 3′ and 5′ ALK signals in an abnormal nucleus, indicating ALK rearrangement, in contrast to the fused signals of a normal nucleus. Immunohistochemical stains (antibodies not labeled in the figure) highlight scattered large neoplastic cells with membranous/Golgi and cytoplasmic positivity among numerous negative cells. Findings are consistent with ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma with a leukemoid neutrophilic reaction; the associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis is not directly demonstrated in these panels.

ddx.vs: Myeloid neoplasms show a clonal left shift or CSF3R/BCR::ABL1 abnormality, whereas here the neutrophilia is reactive and ALK rearrangement is found in rare large lymphoma cells.
Hodgkin cells are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK-negative without ALK break-apart signals.
Morphology can be identical, but ALK protein and ALK rearrangement by FISH are absent.

ddx.dx: ALK-positive large B-cell lymphoma or ALK-rearranged histiocytosis
ddx.vs: These are also ALK+ but ALK-positive LBCL is plasmablastic and CD30-negative, and ALK-histiocytosis expresses CD68/CD163 rather than T-cell markers.

captions: Smear dominated by mature neutrophils (leukemoid reaction)
ALK break-apart FISH: split red/green signals (rearranged) versus fused signals (normal)
IHC: scattered large lymphoma cells with membranous/Golgi staining
IHC: rare large positive cells with cytoplasmic staining

60547.recognize_zh: 兩顆中型淋巴細胞，核輪廓不規則、染色質粗塊狀；中央那顆細胞質中等量、淡藍色，可見散在細小紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），呈大顆粒淋巴球外觀。
features: Two medium-sized lymphocytes with irregular to lobulated nuclear contours
Coarse, clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm containing scattered fine azurophilic granules (best seen in the central cell)
Normochromic red cells with frequent slit-like central pallor
Scattered normal platelets; no blasts
60547.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, many with slit-like central pallor, and adequate platelets. Two medium-sized lymphocytes are present with irregular nuclear contours, coarse mature chromatin, and a moderate amount of pale cytoplasm; the central cell contains scattered fine azurophilic granules. There are no blasts or nucleolated cells. These are large granular lymphocytes, and in the context of chronic lymphocytosis with mild cytopenias and an NK-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: Separated only by immunophenotype and clonality: T-LGL is sCD3+/CD8+/CD57+ with clonal TCR, while NK cells are sCD3-negative with CD16/CD56 and aberrant KIR or CD94/NKG2 expression.
HSTCL cells are usually agranular with more atypical nuclei, gamma-delta TCR, and marked hepatosplenomegaly with sinusoidal marrow infiltration.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant, often scalloped basophilic cytoplasm and resolve with the underlying illness.

60483.recognize_zh: 低中倍可見大型不典型細胞呈黏著性片狀排列，核大、泡狀、形狀不規則，細胞質豐富嗜酸至淡染，散在凋亡細胞與空泡，外觀像癌但為淋巴瘤，符合 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Cohesive sheets of large atypical cells replacing the tissue
Large vesicular, irregular to kidney-shaped nuclei with visible nucleoli
Abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous apoptotic bodies and clear vacuoles (starry/bubbly appearance) with mitoses
Occasional sinus-like space containing tumor cells and debris; scattered neutrophils in areas
60483.describe_en: Section shows diffuse cohesive sheets of large atypical cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, occasional horseshoe or kidney-shaped forms, distinct nucleoli, and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm. Apoptotic bodies, mitoses, and scattered vacuolated spaces are frequent, and tumor cells appear within a sinus-like space. The cohesive growth mimics carcinoma, so a lymphoid origin must be established by immunohistochemistry. With strong uniform CD30 and ALK expression, findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is cytokeratin positive and CD30/ALK negative, whereas ALCL may be EMA positive but keratin negative.
DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks the uniform strong CD30 and ALK positivity with hallmark cells.
Morphology can be identical; ALK immunostain is negative.
Melanoma expresses S100, SOX10, and HMB45/Melan-A and lacks CD30/ALK and T-cell markers.

60355.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD4 免疫染色：瀰漫浸潤的中型腫瘤細胞呈細顆粒狀膜／細胞質染色，強度不一且部分細胞較弱；配合 CD56、CD123 陽性，是 BPDCN 的典型三陽性組合之一。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of intermediate-sized cells with oval to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli replacing marrow between scattered fat spaces
CD4: granular membranous/cytoplasmic staining in a large proportion of tumor cells
Staining intensity is heterogeneous, weak in many cells and stronger in scattered cells
No normal architecture or trilineage elements evident in this field
60355.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on the bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with oval to irregular nuclei and fine chromatin. A substantial proportion of the neoplastic cells show granular membranous and cytoplasmic CD4 staining of variable intensity. In conjunction with coexpression of CD56 and CD123 and the blastic morphology, findings support blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; additional markers such as TCF4, TCL1 and CD303 and lack of MPO, lysozyme and lineage-specific T/B markers help confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML is also CD4+/CD56+ and can be CD123+, but it expresses lysozyme, CD14, CD11c or CD163 and lacks TCF4, TCL1 and CD303.

ddx.dx: Mature T-cell lymphoma (e.g., NK/T-cell or peripheral T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: T-cell lymphomas express CD3 (surface or cytoplasmic) and often cytotoxic markers or EBER, which are absent in BPDCN.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma/marrow involvement by histiocytic neoplasm
ddx.vs: These express CD68, CD163 or MPO rather than the CD123/TCF4/TCL1 plasmacytoid dendritic cell profile.

60227.recognize_zh: 紅血球體積普遍小於左側小淋巴球的核，細胞中央淡染區極大、只剩薄薄一圈血紅素，並夾雜多顆細長的鉛筆狀細胞（pencil cells）與橢圓形細胞，符合嚴重缺鐵性貧血。
features: Marked hypochromia with thin hemoglobin rims and expanded central pallor
Microcytosis compared with the nucleus of the small lymphocyte
Poikilocytosis with numerous elongated pencil cells and oval forms
Small mature lymphocyte with normal morphology
Few platelets in this field
60227.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows severely hypochromic, microcytic red cells with thin peripheral rims of hemoglobin. There is prominent poikilocytosis with numerous elongated pencil cells and ovalocytes. A normal small lymphocyte is present for size comparison. Target cells and basophilic stippling are not prominent. Findings are consistent with severe iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Elliptocytes are normochromic and uniform in size, without the marked hypochromia and microcytosis.
Displays uniform microcytosis with target cells and stippling and only mild hypochromia, with normal iron studies.
Shows a dimorphic red cell population and ring sideroblasts on marrow Prussian blue stain.

60163.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密集，紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞皆增加（三系增生 panmyelosis），並見數顆大型、核分葉過多且多形的巨核細胞（hyperlobated megakaryocytes），缺乏明顯雲朵狀深染核或纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症的增生期。
features: Hypercellular marrow with scant fat
Several large megakaryocytes with hyperlobated, loosely folded nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, focally clustered
Megakaryocytes vary in size (pleomorphic) without markedly hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei
Increased erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei alongside granulocytic precursors (panmyelosis)
No overt fibrosis or sinusoidal streaming in this field
60163.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage proliferation, including increased erythroid precursors and granulocytic elements. Megakaryocytes are increased and pleomorphic, ranging to large forms with hyperlobated nuclei, and are focally loosely clustered. Megakaryocytes with dense hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and stromal fibrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm showing panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera in the proliferative (polycythemic) phase.

ddx.vs: Proliferation is mainly of large to giant staghorn megakaryocytes with normal cellularity and no significant erythroid or granulocytic expansion.
Megakaryocytes form dense clusters with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, with granulocytic rather than erythroid predominance.
Shows erythroid hyperplasia only, without megakaryocytic pleomorphism or panmyelosis, and lacks JAK2 mutation with normal or high EPO.

60099.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度填滿（packed marrow），由單形性的中到大型芽細胞成片取代，核圓至卵圓、染色質淡、可見核仁，細胞質中等量，正常造血僅剩零星紅系與嗜酸性細胞；抽吸乾抽（dry tap）時要靠切片診斷並做網狀纖維染色。
features: Packed, 100% cellular marrow with sheets of immature cells
Medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin and small distinct nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale amphophilic cytoplasm with discernible cell borders
Scant residual erythroid precursors and eosinophils; mature megakaryocytes not conspicuous in this field
Scattered mitotic figures; fibrosis cannot be assessed on H&E alone
60099.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is packed and essentially 100% cellular, composed of sheets of medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm. Residual hematopoiesis is limited to scattered erythroid precursors and eosinophils, and mature megakaryocytes are not conspicuous. Occasional mitotic figures are present. Given the dry tap, reticulin staining and immunohistochemistry (CD61, CD42b, CD34) are warranted; findings are consistent with acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: APMF shows trilineage proliferation with dysplastic megakaryocytes and marked fibrosis rather than a monotonous blast sheet.
PMF has clustered atypical mature megakaryocytes, osteosclerosis and prior MPN history with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by lymphoma or metastatic tumor
ddx.vs: Immunohistochemistry (CD45, lymphoid, keratin, CD61) distinguishes non-myeloid infiltrates, which can also cause a dry tap.

60035.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中央可見兩顆巨核細胞，其細胞核分成多個彼此分離、圓形的小核（separated nuclear lobes），而非正常相連的分葉核，是骨髓發育不良（dysmegakaryopoiesis）的特徵，符合伴隨骨髓發育不良變化的 AML。
features: Megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes ('pawn-ball' or multinucleated forms)
Megakaryocyte nuclei are small relative to the abundant pink granular cytoplasm
Background of crowded immature mononuclear cells with fine to vesicular chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and red cells
Adjacent fat space at right; high power limits assessment of overall cellularity and blast percentage
60035.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows megakaryocytes with multiple discrete, widely separated round nuclear lobes embedded in abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. The surrounding marrow contains numerous immature mononuclear cells with vesicular chromatin, admixed with erythroid precursors. The overall cellularity and blast proportion cannot be quantified from this field and require CD34 immunohistochemistry and aspirate differential. The megakaryocytic dysplasia is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with connected lobes, whereas these nuclei are fully separated into discrete round units.
Megaloblastic change can produce hyperlobated megakaryocytes but shows megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open chromatin and giant metamyelocytes without an increase in blasts.

ddx.dx: Treatment or growth factor effect (e.g., post-chemotherapy regeneration)
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow may show transient megakaryocytic atypia, so history and persistence on repeat sampling, plus cytogenetics, help separate it from true MDS-related dysplasia.
The same dysplasia occurs in MDS; the distinction rests on blast count (20% or more for AML), which is not measurable in this field.

29315.recognize_zh: 切片為單一型態、核輪廓略不規則的中小型淋巴球瀰漫浸潤，周邊血中有核形不規則或有切跡的非典型淋巴球，骨髓亦有間質性浸潤並以核染色免疫標記呈群聚陽性，符合白血病化的套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclear contours, dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, without admixed centroblasts or tingible-body macrophages (panel A)
Circulating atypical lymphoid cells of medium size with irregular, indented nuclear outlines, moderately condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm (panel B)
Hypercellular marrow with interstitial-to-diffuse infiltration by small monotonous lymphoid cells and residual fat (panel C)
Cluster of nuclear-positive cells on immunohistochemistry of a marrow preparation (panel D; marker not labeled, e.g. cyclin D1/SOX11)
29315.describe_en: Tissue sections (spleen) show effacement by a diffuse, monotonous population of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; no large transformed cells or starry-sky pattern are seen. The peripheral blood smear contains atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, notched nuclei and scant cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular with an interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate of similar cells, and nuclear immunostaining highlights a cluster of neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with splenic, marrow and leukemic involvement, pending confirmation with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14).

ddx.vs: CLL cells are round with block-type clumped chromatin and form proliferation centers, and are CD23-positive and cyclin D1-negative.
SMZL shows biphasic white-pulp nodules with pale marginal-zone cells and villous lymphocytes in blood, lacking cyclin D1 and t(11;14).
FL cells are deeply cleaved centrocytes that are CD10/BCL6-positive and cyclin D1-negative with t(14;18).
Blastoid variants have finer chromatin and very high Ki-67, and lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT-positive, whereas this infiltrate appears classic small-to-medium sized.

19843.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 低倍（A）可見多個縮小、萎縮的生發中心散布於擴張的濾泡間區，高倍（B）可見外套層細胞同心圓排列成洋蔥皮樣（onion-skin）包圍玻璃樣變的生發中心，符合 Castleman 病型態，臨床配合周邊神經病變指向 POEMS。
features: Preserved but distorted nodal architecture with numerous small regressed (atrophic) germinal centers (panel A)
Expanded mantle zones with concentric onion-skin layering of small lymphocytes around follicles (panel B)
Hyalinized, eosinophilic germinal centers, some with penetrating small vessels
Expanded interfollicular areas with increased small vessels; plasma cell content not resolvable at this magnification
No sheets of atypical large cells or effacement by a monotonous infiltrate
19843.describe_en: Lymph node section shows preserved but altered architecture with numerous small regressed germinal centers distributed through expanded interfollicular areas. At higher power the follicles show hyalinized, eosinophilic germinal centers surrounded by broad mantle zones with concentric onion-skin layering of small lymphocytes, and the interfollicular region contains increased small vessels. Interfollicular plasma cell sheets cannot be assessed at this magnification, and no atypical large-cell infiltrate is seen. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease with regressed, hyaline-vascular-type follicles; in a patient with peripheral neuropathy, correlation with a lambda-restricted monoclonal plasma cell disorder, VEGF level, and other POEMS criteria is recommended.

ddx.vs: Unicentric disease shows the same follicular changes but presents as a single enlarged node without neuropathy, monoclonal protein, or systemic POEMS features.
HHV8-MCD shows interfollicular plasma cell sheets with LANA-1 positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones, whereas POEMS-associated disease is HHV8 negative.

Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back crowded neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles, loss of polarity, and BCL2-positive germinal centers rather than regressed follicles with onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphadenopathy of HIV, autoimmune disease, or IgG4-related disease
ddx.vs: These can show regressed follicles and plasmacytosis but lack prominent onion-skin mantles and are separated by serology, IgG4:IgG ratio, and clinical context.

19395.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中除了典型小淋巴球與兩個破碎的污斑細胞（smudge cells）外，還混有較大、帶明顯核仁的前淋巴球（上方）與細胞質較多、核偏心的大型淋巴球，細胞形態不一，符合 CLL 混合細胞型（mixed cell type / atypical CLL）。
features: Heterogeneous lymphoid population rather than uniform small lymphocytes
Larger cell with moderate pale-blue cytoplasm, round nucleus, and a visible central nucleolus consistent with a prolymphocyte (top)
Medium-sized lymphoid cell with more abundant blue cytoplasm and slightly irregular nucleus (lower left)
Small mature lymphocyte with condensed clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (bottom right)
Two smudge cells with disrupted streaky chromatin
Red cells largely normocytic with occasional stomatocytic/drying artifact
19395.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocytosis composed of a heterogeneous population, including small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin, larger lymphoid cells with more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm, and a cell with a prominent central nucleolus consistent with a prolymphocyte. Smudge cells are present. Red cells show no significant abnormality apart from minor drying artifact. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia of mixed cell type (atypical CLL); the proportion of prolymphocytes should be quantified (10-55%) and a CLL immunophenotype (CD5+, CD23+, CD200+, dim sIg) confirmed, with exclusion of mantle cell lymphoma by cyclin D1 or t(11;14).

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows medium cells with irregular or cleaved nuclei and is CD23-negative/CD200-negative with cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
Prolymphocytic leukemia requires more than 55% prolymphocytes with a monomorphic nucleolated population, whereas here small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells predominate.
SMZL cells show short polar villous projections and plasmacytoid features, and are usually CD5-negative and CD23-negative.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with high proliferation in tissue, rather than scattered larger cells in a CLL blood background.

17731.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓切片中有一個界線清楚的肉芽腫，中央為淡染、細胞質豐富的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），周圍環繞小淋巴球與纖維化，中央無乾酪樣壞死，符合骨髓類肉瘤病（sarcoidosis）的非乾酪性肉芽腫。
features: Well-circumscribed granuloma abutting a bony trabecula
Central aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated, vesicular slipper-shaped nuclei
No central caseous or fibrinoid necrosis
Peripheral rim of small lymphocytes with concentric fibroblastic/fibrotic stroma
Surrounding marrow is paucicellular in this field with fibrous tissue at upper left
17731.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a well-formed, compact granuloma adjacent to a bony trabecula. The granuloma is composed of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated vesicular nuclei, rimmed by small lymphocytes and concentric fibrosis. No caseous necrosis is identified. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing (non-caseating) granuloma, compatible with sarcoidosis in the appropriate clinical context after exclusion of infection with AFB and fungal stains and cultures.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show central caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, and AFB stain, culture or PCR is needed to exclude infection even in non-necrotizing granulomas.
Fungal granulomas may be necrotizing and contain yeast forms visible on GMS or PAS stain.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or other lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated granulomas are accompanied by atypical cells such as CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells or a clonal lymphoid population.
Lipogranulomas are small, contain lipid vacuoles and lack the compact epithelioid architecture and fibrotic rim seen here.

16387.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成熟嗜中性球的細胞核分成多個濃縮、固縮狀（pyknotic）的小葉，彼此以細長的染色質絲相連，細胞質有空泡，這種「骨髓滯留」（myelokathexis）是 WHIM 症候群（CXCR4 突變）的特徵。
features: Panel C (BM aspirate): mature neutrophils with multiple condensed, pyknotic, hyperclumped nuclear lobes
Lobes separated and joined by long, thin chromatin filaments (myelokathexis)
Neutrophil cytoplasm with pink specific granules and scattered clear vacuoles
Panel A (PB): isolated neutrophil with similar hypersegmented, dense lobes; leukocytes sparse, consistent with neutropenia
Panel B (BM biopsy H&E): hypercellular marrow with granulocytic predominance and accumulation of mature forms
16387.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel A) shows few leukocytes, with a neutrophil containing multiple dense, separated nuclear lobes. The bone marrow biopsy (panel B) is hypercellular with a granulocyte-predominant population and many maturing myeloid cells, and the aspirate (panel C) shows numerous mature neutrophils with hypersegmented, pyknotic nuclear lobes connected by long thin chromatin strands and vacuolated cytoplasm. This combination of peripheral neutropenia with marrow retention of senescent neutrophils is characteristic of myelokathexis. In a patient with warts, hypogammaglobulinemia, infections and a CXCR4 mutation, findings are consistent with WHIM syndrome.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic hypersegmentation shows well-formed lobes with normal chromatin plus giant metamyelocytes and megaloblastic erythroid precursors, rather than pyknotic apoptotic-looking lobes on long filaments.
Storage artifact shows round dense nuclear fragments in a delayed specimen affecting many cell types, without the clinical neutropenia and hypercellular marrow.
SCN shows a maturation arrest at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage with few mature neutrophils, the opposite of marrow accumulation of mature forms.
MDS shows hypogranularity and pseudo-Pelger hyposegmentation with clonal abnormalities rather than hyperclumped hypersegmented lobes.

13443.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大量紅血球失去中央淡染區、變成小而緻密的球形，並伴隨許多細小的紅血球碎片與出芽狀微球體（microspherocytes/fragments），均勻遍布整個視野；這是檢體受熱造成的紅血球熱傷害假象，碎片可被分析儀誤計為血小板。
features: Diffuse loss of central pallor with many small, dense, round microspherocytes
Numerous tiny red cell fragments and budding forms of variable size throughout the field
Some red cells with small surface blebs or attached fragments
Uniform involvement across the smear rather than a focal area
Occasional small platelet clump; no leukocytes or schistocyte-dominant helmet forms
13443.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows diffuse red cell alteration, with loss of central pallor, numerous dense microspherocytes and abundant tiny red cell fragments and buds distributed uniformly throughout the field. A small platelet clump is present. The appearance is uniform and lacks the helmet cells and triangular schistocytes of microangiopathic hemolysis. Findings are consistent with thermal (heat) artifact of the specimen; the red cell fragments may be counted as platelets by impedance analyzers, causing spurious elevation of the platelet count, and a fresh, properly handled sample should be examined.

ddx.vs: Burn patients show identical microspherocytes and budding fragments, so clinical history of burns versus specimen overheating is the only discriminator.
HPP shows the same fragmentation and microspherocytes in fresh samples from a patient with lifelong hemolysis and very low MCV, with spectrin defects on testing.
MAHA shows helmet cells and triangular schistocytes with thrombocytopenia rather than uniform budding microspherocytes.
HS shows spherocytes without abundant tiny red cell fragments and buds.

9475.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見足背近趾根處一大片出血性、表皮剝脫的壞死潰瘍，小腿另有數個小的黑色痂皮；外觀本身不具專一性，要結合剛開始使用 warfarin（常合併 protein C 缺乏）的病史才能判斷為 warfarin 引起的皮膚壞死。
features: Large irregular hemorrhagic ulcer with denuded epidermis and dark red-brown crust on the dorsal forefoot near the toe bases
Serosanguinous exudate and a pale, macerated area at the ulcer margin
Several smaller discrete dark eschars on the distal leg and ankle
Surrounding skin without obvious purpuric net-like (retiform) pattern at this resolution
Acral distal location; the classic fatty-area predilection (breast, thigh, buttock) is not illustrated
9475.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the dorsum of the foot and distal leg shows a large, irregular, hemorrhagic, ulcerated and crusted necrotic lesion over the forefoot, with several smaller dark eschars on the leg. The appearance indicates full-thickness skin necrosis but is not specific by itself, and the image resolution is limited. Correlation with recent initiation of warfarin (typically within 3 to 5 days, often without heparin bridging) and protein C or S levels is required. In that clinical context, the findings are consistent with warfarin-induced skin necrosis.

ddx.vs: HIT occurs 5 to 10 days after heparin exposure with a platelet count fall and positive PF4/heparin antibody and functional assays, rather than after warfarin initiation.

ddx.dx: Purpura fulminans (severe protein C deficiency or sepsis/DIC)
ddx.vs: Purpura fulminans presents with rapidly spreading retiform purpura, often symmetric and acral, accompanied by laboratory DIC or congenital homozygous protein C deficiency.
Calciphylaxis typically affects patients with end-stage renal disease and shows painful retiform purpura with vascular calcification on biopsy.

ddx.dx: Pyoderma gangrenosum or infectious ulcer (e.g. ecthyma gangrenosum)
ddx.vs: These show undermined violaceous borders or positive cultures and neutrophil-rich histology rather than dermal vessel thrombosis without inflammation.

9923.recognize_zh: 這是小鼠脾臟的巨觀照片：表面突起多個界線清楚、顏色較淡的圓形結節，每個結節就是一個由單一移植造血幹/前驅細胞長成的脾臟群落（CFU-S，Till 與 McCulloch 實驗）。
features: Gross (black-and-white) photograph of an elongated mouse spleen
Multiple discrete, round, raised, pale macroscopic nodules on the splenic surface
Nodules vary in size and are separated by darker normal splenic parenchyma
Each nodule represents a clonal hematopoietic colony (CFU-S) formed after transplantation into an irradiated recipient
9923.describe_en: Gross photograph of a mouse spleen shows multiple discrete, round, pale, raised nodules of varying size scattered over the capsular surface against darker background parenchyma. In the context of the spleen colony-forming unit assay, each nodule is a clonal colony arising from a single transplanted bone marrow progenitor in a lethally irradiated recipient, counted about 8 to 12 days after injection. This classic experiment by Till and McCulloch provided the first functional evidence of hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells with multilineage and self-renewal capacity. The image is experimental and not diagnostic of human disease.

ddx.vs: Infarcts are wedge-shaped, subcapsular and often pale or hemorrhagic with a base at the capsule, rather than round raised nodules in an irradiated host.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by lymphoma or metastatic tumor nodules
ddx.vs: Tumor nodules show atypical monomorphous cells on histology, whereas CFU-S colonies contain maturing erythroid, myeloid and megakaryocytic cells.

2947.recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨大多核細胞含有數十個大小一致、彼此分開的卵圓形核，細胞質豐富淡藍並有細顆粒，是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）；在腎性骨失養症（renal osteodystrophy）的次發性副甲狀腺亢進中，骨髓抹片常見蝕骨細胞增加。
features: Giant multinucleated cell with dozens of uniform, discrete, round-to-oval nuclei
Nuclei with fine chromatin and small single nucleoli, clustered centrally
Abundant pale blue to lilac cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and a frayed border
Surrounding peripheral blood elements and occasional leukocytes
No nuclear atypia or mitotic activity
2947.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant multinucleated cell containing numerous uniform, separate, oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, set in abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm. The morphology is that of an osteoclast and there is no nuclear atypia. Osteoclasts are uncommon in normal adult aspirates, and their presence reflects increased bone resorption. In a patient with chronic kidney disease, findings are consistent with increased osteoclastic activity of renal osteodystrophy (secondary hyperparathyroidism).

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobulated, hyperchromatic nucleus with pink granular cytoplasm rather than many discrete, uniform nuclei.
Myeloma cells usually contain only a few pleomorphic nuclei with clumped chromatin and a perinuclear hof in deeply basophilic cytoplasm.
Carcinoma clusters are composed of separate cohesive cells with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, not a single syncytial cell with identical nuclei.
Histiocytic giant cells have nuclei arranged peripherally or haphazardly with associated granulomatous inflammation and lack azurophilic osteoclast granules.

1411.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞成片出現、幾乎取代正常造血：細胞核偏心、細胞質豐富灰藍、核旁有淡染 hof，細胞大小一致並彼此擠壓成多角形，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing normal marrow elements
Eccentric round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; occasional nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof
Cells molded against one another into polygonal shapes
Few residual small erythroid precursors and granulocytes between the plasma cells
1411.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of plasma cells that largely replace normal hematopoietic elements. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof; the cells are closely packed and molded against each other. Only scattered erythroid precursors and granulocytes remain. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification and confirmation of light chain restriction are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytosis rarely forms sheets and is polytypic for kappa and lambda, whereas this marrow is largely replaced by plasma cells.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with an IgM paraprotein, not sheets of uniform plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows large cells with open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBER positive, rather than well-differentiated plasma cells.

1219.recognize_zh: 這張抽吸液中大量細胞核呈摺疊、凹陷或腎形，胞質灰藍、帶細顆粒（promonocytes/monocytes），同時混有核圓、胞質較藍的骨髓母細胞，左側還有一顆嗜酸性顆粒球；單核系與顆粒系同時增加，符合急性骨髓單核球性白血病（AMML）。
features: Large cells with folded, lobulated or kidney-shaped nuclei and delicate chromatin (promonocytes/monocytes)
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dusty azurophilic granules and occasional vacuoles
Admixed myeloblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered maturing granulocytes and an eosinophil with orange granules at left
Densely cellular field with few erythroid precursors
1219.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field composed of a mixed population of immature myeloid and monocytic cells. Many cells are large with abundant gray-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and folded, indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with delicate chromatin, consistent with promonocytes and immature monocytes. Admixed are myeloblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm, together with occasional maturing granulocytes and an eosinophil. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia, provided blasts and promonocytes total >=20% and both neutrophil and monocytic lineages each constitute >=20% of cells, confirmed by MPO and nonspecific esterase or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Requires >=80% monocytic lineage cells with <20% granulocytic cells, whereas a substantial myeloblast/granulocytic component is visible here.
Similar myelomonocytic picture but with abnormal eosinophils bearing large purple-violet granules, confirmed by CBFB::MYH11; the eosinophil here should be scrutinized for such granules.
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes with mostly mature monocytes, while this field is dominated by immature forms.

1283.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混有數顆明顯大於造血前驅細胞的非典型大細胞，左上方一顆核呈雙葉/凹陷、細胞質深藍，中央一顆細胞質有細小空泡；構造提示淋巴瘤浸潤，但顆粒不明顯，譜系需靠免疫染色與 EBER 確認。
features: Scattered large atypical cells, clearly larger than adjacent myeloid and erythroid precursors
Moderate N:C ratio with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Cleaved/bilobed nucleus in one cell; round-oval nuclei in others
Finely granular to slightly coarse chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles in one large cell; azurophilic granules not conspicuous
Background of residual granulocytic precursors, an erythroid precursor and red cells
1283.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows residual trilineage hematopoietic elements with several admixed large atypical cells. These cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm, which is finely vacuolated in one cell, and round to cleaved or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. Azurophilic granules are not readily identified in this field, and the morphology alone does not establish lineage. Correlation with immunophenotyping (cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, TIA-1/granzyme B) and EBER in situ hybridization is required. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by lymphoma and compatible with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; distinction depends on a systemic leukemic presentation with extensive marrow and blood involvement rather than an extranodal primary.
Myeloblasts have fine blast chromatin with nucleoli, may contain Auer rods, and are MPO/CD34/CD117-positive, unlike NK/T lymphoma cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are also large and basophilic but express CD20/PAX5 and lack CD56 and cytotoxic markers.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1-positive, which requires immunostaining to exclude.

1027.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全是紅血球系前驅細胞：大型原紅血球（proerythroblast）胞質深藍、染色質細緻，並有雙核與巨母細胞樣（megaloblastoid）的紅血球母細胞，骨髓系細胞很少。
features: Marked predominance of erythroid precursors at all stages, with many large proerythroblasts
Proerythroblasts: large cells with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Dysplastic erythroid forms including binucleated and megaloblastoid erythroblasts with checkered chromatin
Some cells show irregular or lobulated nuclear contours
Few granulocytic precursors and neutrophils in the field
1027.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen dominated by erythroid precursors. Numerous large proerythroblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and intensely basophilic cytoplasm are present, admixed with basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts showing megaloblastoid change, binucleation, and irregular nuclear contours. Granulocytic elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia); confirmation requires a differential count showing >80% erythroid precursors with >=30% proerythroblasts and exclusion of other causes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows orderly maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, without a dominant population of proerythroblasts, and corrects with B12/folate.
MDS may show erythroid hyperplasia and dysplasia, but proerythroblasts do not reach >=30% of nucleated cells.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions but with maturation arrest and marked reduction of later erythroid forms, rather than neoplastic sheets.
Megakaryoblasts can also have basophilic blebbing cytoplasm; CD41/CD61 positivity versus E-cadherin/CD71/glycophorin A positivity separates them.

4099.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血腔被流線狀（streaming）排列的梭形纖維母細胞與膠原取代，其中夾雜深染、成簇的非典型巨核細胞核，周圍骨小樑增厚，符合原發性骨髓纖維化的纖維化期。
features: Intertrabecular space replaced by collagenous fibrosis with streaming spindle cells
Clusters of hyperchromatic, distorted nuclei consistent with atypical megakaryocytes
Markedly reduced normal hematopoiesis and adipocytes
Thickened, irregular bony trabeculae suggesting osteosclerosis
Dilated sinusoidal spaces with hemorrhage at the periphery
4099.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows intertrabecular marrow spaces largely replaced by fibrous tissue with a streaming arrangement of spindle cells. Clusters of hyperchromatic, irregular megakaryocyte nuclei are embedded in the fibrosis, while normal hematopoietic elements and fat are markedly reduced. Bony trabeculae appear thickened. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin/trichrome grading and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical and separation depends on documented prior PV or ET history.
Metastatic tumor forms cohesive epithelial nests that are keratin-positive rather than clustered megakaryocytes.
Reactive fibrosis in infection, renal osteodystrophy or autoimmune disease lacks clustered atypical megakaryocytes and a driver mutation.

3907.recognize_zh: 周邊血中出現遠大於正常淋巴球的異常大細胞，核形不規則、染色質細緻，胞質嗜鹼性，右上那顆還有許多空泡；中間一顆已破裂成拖尾狀，這種大型脆弱淋巴細胞符合大細胞淋巴瘤的白血病期。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells several times the size of red cells
Irregular, angulated nuclei with finely granular to open chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell with numerous cytoplasmic vacuoles
Fragile cells: one disrupted cell with smeared, streaming chromatin
Background red cells with target-like central pallor changes and drying artifact
3907.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei, finely granular chromatin and a moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, one of which contains numerous cytoplasmic vacuoles. A disrupted cell with smeared chromatin reflects cellular fragility. No granules or Auer rods are identified. In the context of a known large B-cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with leukemic involvement, to be confirmed by flow cytometry for a clonal mature B-cell population.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have finer chromatin, less vacuolated cytoplasm and may show granules or Auer rods, and they express CD34/CD117/MPO rather than CD20 and surface light chain.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing lipid vacuoles, and they carry MYC rearrangement with a Ki-67 index near 100%.
Reactive lymphocytes form a spectrum with normal lymphocytes and are polyclonal by flow cytometry.

3779.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球比小淋巴球稍大，圓形細胞核略偏一側、染色質粗塊狀，周圍有一圈比一般淋巴球更多、更藍的細胞質，外觀介於淋巴球與漿細胞之間，即淋巴漿細胞樣淋巴球（lymphoplasmacytoid lymphocyte）；未見明顯核周淡染區（hof）。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cell, about 1.5 times an RBC
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin; no visible nucleolus
Moderate rim of basophilic blue cytoplasm, more than a typical small lymphocyte
No distinct perinuclear hof and no cytoplasmic granules
Background RBCs without rouleaux; scattered platelets present
3779.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphoid cell with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin without nucleoli, and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm is more abundant and deeper blue than in a resting small lymphocyte, but a well-formed perinuclear hof and fully eccentric plasma-cell nucleus are not seen. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a lymphoplasmacytoid lymphocyte, which may be seen in lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia or in reactive states.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have a markedly eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, a prominent perinuclear hof and abundant deep blue cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around neighboring RBCs and shows peripheral basophilia.
CLL-type lymphocytes have only a scant cytoplasmic rim with a centrally placed nucleus and soccer-ball chromatin.

3587.recognize_zh: 淋巴球變大，細胞質豐富、淡藍色，與旁邊紅血球相接處的邊緣顏色較深藍；核呈卵圓形、染色質稍疏鬆，看不到明顯核仁。這是反應性（非典型）淋巴球的樣子。
features: Enlarged lymphocyte, about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter
Oval nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and some parachromatin clearing; no prominent nucleolus
Moderate to abundant pale-blue cytoplasm with a darker basophilic rim at the periphery
Cytoplasm molds around adjacent RBCs
A few small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles near the lower edge
Background RBCs normochromic, normocytic
3587.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged lymphocyte with an oval nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin with slight parachromatin clearing, and no prominent nucleolus. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale blue, with a deeper basophilic rim and molding around adjacent red cells. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a reactive (atypical) lymphocyte, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have very fine chromatin, often nucleoli, and a high N:C ratio with scant cytoplasm.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue ground-glass cytoplasm that does not show peripheral basophilia molding around RBCs.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, deep blue cytoplasm, and a perinuclear hof.
LGLs contain distinct azurophilic cytoplasmic granules, which are absent here.

3715.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大多核細胞，約八個彼此分離、大小一致的圓至卵圓形細胞核，染色質細緻、各有小核仁，散布於豐富淡藍灰色、細顆粒的細胞質中；核是分開的而不是單一分葉核，這點區分蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）與巨核細胞。
features: Very large multinucleated cell with approximately eight separate nuclei
Nuclei round to oval, uniform in size, with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granularity and irregular frayed borders
Nuclei are discrete and not interconnected, unlike a megakaryocyte's single lobulated nucleus
Background red cells with drying/refractile artifact
3715.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large multinucleated cell containing approximately eight discrete, uniform, round-to-oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, pale blue-gray, and finely granular with irregular borders. The nuclei are separate rather than forming a single multilobated nucleus, and there is no nuclear atypia. Findings are consistent with an osteoclast, a normal marrow constituent more often seen in pediatric aspirates or states of increased bone turnover.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobulated, interconnected nucleus with pink granular cytoplasm rather than multiple separate uniform nuclei.
Osteoblasts are separate mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof, occurring in groups rather than fused in one cytoplasm.
Malignant giant cells show pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei with irregular nucleoli rather than bland uniform nuclei.
Histiocytic giant cells occur with granulomas or foreign material and may show peripheral horseshoe nuclear arrangement.

3651.recognize_zh: 細胞豐富的骨髓抹片，以顆粒球系為主並呈現骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核至分葉核的連續成熟，夾有核深染的紅血球前驅細胞與少數淋巴球及脂肪空泡，成熟順序正常、無芽細胞增加，符合正常成人骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate with predominance of maturing granulocytic cells
Orderly maturation from myelocytes through metamyelocytes and bands to segmented neutrophils
Interspersed erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and occasional small lymphocytes
No increase in blasts and no dysplastic features
Scattered fat vacuoles at the particle edge
3651.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular spread near a particle edge with mixed hematopoietic elements. Granulocytic cells predominate and show orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with interspersed erythroid precursors and occasional lymphocytes. Blasts are not increased and no dysplasia or abnormal infiltrate is identified; megakaryocytes are not included in this field. Findings are consistent with normal adult bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Features increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio with toxic granulation and a left shift beyond what is seen here.
Shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with basophilia, eosinophilia, and dwarf megakaryocytes.
Requires dysplasia in at least 10% of cells of a lineage, such as hypogranular neutrophils or megaloblastoid erythroids.

3523.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球含有一小群聚集、形狀不規則的藍紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），另一個淡染紅血球內有多處零散顆粒，這些含鐵顆粒的紅血球即鐵粒紅血球（siderocytes）。
features: Red cells with small clustered, irregular blue-purple granules (arrows)
One pale ovalocyte-like red cell with multiple granule clusters
Granules smaller and more irregular than Howell-Jolly bodies
A teardrop-shaped cell with granules at right, plus occasional single tiny dots in other RBCs
Mild anisocytosis; scattered platelets
3523.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with scattered erythrocytes containing small clusters of irregular basophilic granules, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies (arrows). One pale red cell contains multiple granule clusters, and occasional single fine dots are present in other cells. The inclusion-bearing cells correspond to siderocytes, which can be confirmed by Prussian blue staining. Findings are consistent with siderocytes.

ddx.vs: Basophilic stippling shows evenly distributed ribosomal granules throughout the RBC that are iron stain negative.
Howell-Jolly bodies are solitary round dense DNA remnants, not multiple irregular clustered granules.
Babesia shows ring or pear-shaped forms, sometimes as tetrads, with a defined cytoplasmic outline rather than amorphous granules.

3459.recognize_zh: 大量中大型異常細胞，細胞質充滿細緻紫紅色顆粒而遮蓋核邊界，箭頭所指細胞的核呈雙葉或摺疊（bilobed / folded）狀，這種「顆粒多、核分葉」的組合是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）異常前骨髓細胞的典型外觀。
features: Sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes with moderate to abundant cytoplasm
Nuclei folded, reniform or bilobed (arrow), with nuclear outlines partly obscured by granules
Cytoplasm densely packed with fine azurophilic (violet) granules
Fine chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous because of overlying granules
No definite Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) identifiable in this field
Scattered small mature lymphocytes/erythroid precursors among the abnormal cells
3459.describe_en: The smear is highly cellular and dominated by large abnormal promyelocytes. These cells have abundant cytoplasm filled with fine, dense azurophilic granules that obscure the nuclear border, and many nuclei are folded or bilobed (arrow). Chromatin is fine and nucleoli are masked by granules. Definite Auer rod bundles are not identified in this field, and normal maturing granulocytes are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); confirmation of PML::RARA and urgent evaluation for DIC are required.

ddx.vs: Blasts show less cytoplasmic granulation and round nuclei with visible nucleoli, with a spectrum of maturing neutrophils, whereas APL cells are uniformly hypergranular with bilobed nuclei and absent PML::RARA is decisive.
Promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei but gray-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, rather than dense azurophilic granules and strong MPO.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow (e.g., G-CSF or agranulocytosis recovery)
ddx.vs: Recovering promyelocytes have a clear perinuclear Golgi zone, round nuclei and orderly maturation, lacking bilobed nuclei and PML::RARA.

3139.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被一片形態單一的中至大型母細胞占滿，N:C比高、核圓或橢圓帶淺凹、染色質細緻均勻、核仁小而不明顯，胞質少量淡藍色且無顆粒，符合前驅B淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Sheet of monotonous medium to large blasts replacing normal marrow elements
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei, some with shallow indentations or clefts
Finely dispersed, evenly distributed chromatin
Small, indistinct nucleoli in some cells
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
3139.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of monotonous medium to large blasts with high N:C ratios and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to oval, occasionally indented, with finely dispersed chromatin and small inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods or granules are identified, and normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; B lineage requires confirmation by flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD79a, TdT) along with cytogenetic and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Minimally differentiated myeloblasts can look identical and are separated by flow cytometry showing myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117, MPO) and absence of B-lineage antigens.
T-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require cytoplasmic CD3 expression without B-lineage markers.
Hematogones are smaller with smoother condensed chromatin and show a normal maturation continuum on flow cytometry instead of sheets of arrested blasts.
Blastoid MCL cells are mature B cells that are surface light chain restricted, CD5+ and cyclin D1+, and TdT negative.

3011.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片低倍下真皮內有密集、彌漫的淋巴樣浸潤，由表皮下一直延伸到深層，表面有血痂或出血覆蓋，表皮本身沒有明顯的表皮趨向性（epidermotropism），這種以真皮結節為主的樣式符合原發性皮膚退行性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate occupying the papillary and reticular dermis
Infiltrate composed of mixed-size cells, including larger cells with pale cytoplasm, at low power
Overlying epidermis with acanthosis and a surface crust of blood and fibrin
No conspicuous epidermotropism or Pautrier microabscesses
Prominent small vessels within the infiltrate
3011.describe_en: Low-power view of a skin biopsy shows a dense, diffuse cellular infiltrate filling the dermis immediately beneath the epidermis and extending into the deeper dermis, with numerous small vessels. The overlying epidermis is mildly acanthotic and covered by a hemorrhagic serum crust, without conspicuous epidermotropism. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, although larger cells with pale cytoplasm are apparent within the infiltrate. The dermal nodular pattern is compatible with primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma, which requires high-power evaluation and CD30/ALK immunostaining for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Tumor-stage MF arises with a history of patches/plaques and often retains epidermotropism, whereas pcALCL presents de novo as a nodule without prior MF.
LyP lesions are smaller, wedge-shaped, and self-regressing clinically, while this dense diffuse infiltrate suggests a persistent nodule.
B-cell lymphomas often show a grenz zone with follicular or diffuse CD20-positive cells rather than CD30-positive T cells.
Reactive infiltrates are wedge-shaped, polymorphous with eosinophils, and lack sheets of atypical CD30-positive large cells.

2819.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞密集，除成熟顆粒球外，有多顆大型、染色質細緻的母細胞與早幼粒細胞，並可見嗜酸性骨髓細胞與含深色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球，提示 CML 進展期的母細胞與嗜鹼性球增加。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic predominance
Numerous large immature cells (blasts/promyelocytes) with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Eosinophilic myelocytes with orange-red granules
Basophils/basophilic precursors with coarse dark purple granules
Maturing myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils; a small dark nucleated red cell
2819.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and a conspicuous immature component, including large blasts and promyelocytes with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Eosinophilic myelocytes and basophils with coarse dark granules are readily seen, along with maturing neutrophils. A 500-cell differential is needed to document blast (10-19%) and basophil (>=20%) thresholds. In a patient with BCR::ABL1-positive CML, findings are consistent with accelerated phase.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase marrow has <10% blasts and less prominent basophilia, while cell types present are otherwise similar.
Blast phase requires >=20% blasts, and lymphoid blast phase would show TdT+ B- or T-lymphoblasts.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 neoplasms show eosinophilia without BCR::ABL1 and require FISH or molecular testing.

2627.recognize_zh: 鐵染色骨髓抹片左側一串紅母細胞的核周幾乎都圍著一圈藍色鐵顆粒，而右側的帶狀核、分葉嗜中性球與早期大細胞沒有鐵顆粒，形成明顯對比，符合大量環狀鐵粒母細胞。
features: Prussian blue-stained aspirate with red nuclear counterstain
Numerous erythroid precursors with coarse blue granules in a perinuclear ring distribution
Siderotic granules restricted to erythroid precursors; band and segmented neutrophils lack iron
Large early precursors with fine chromatin are iron negative
Fat space at lower right and occasional extracellular granules in background
2627.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a ring around the nucleus, consistent with ring sideroblasts. The iron granules are confined to erythroid precursors; adjacent band and segmented neutrophils and larger early precursors are iron negative. Ring sideroblasts appear to make up a large proportion of erythroid precursors in this field, although a formal count is needed. Findings are consistent with numerous ring sideroblasts, supporting myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have one to a few fine granules without perinuclear arrangement and are much less conspicuous.
These produce ring sideroblasts with cytoplasmic vacuolization of precursors and neutropenia, identified by low serum copper and ceruloplasmin.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts look the same, but this entity requires sustained thrombocytosis and proliferative megakaryocytes.

2371.recognize_zh: Kleihauer-Betke 酸洗脫染色中，整片紅血球都只剩淡粉紅的「鬼影」空殼（成人 HbA 已被酸洗出），此視野沒有看到被伊紅深染、充滿血紅素的胎兒紅血球（HbF 細胞）。
features: Uniform field of pale pink ghost red cells with only membrane outlines retained
Cells appear empty after acid elution of adult hemoglobin (HbA)
No darkly eosin-stained, hemoglobin-filled acid-resistant (HbF-containing) red cells in this field
No nucleated cells or leukocytes identifiable; densely packed monolayer
2371.describe_en: Kleihauer-Betke acid elution preparation of peripheral blood shows a field of pale ghost red cells in which adult hemoglobin has been eluted, leaving only faintly stained membrane outlines. No acid-resistant, darkly staining fetal hemoglobin–containing cells are identified in this field. Interpretation requires counting a large number of cells (typically 2,000) with appropriate positive and negative controls to calculate the percentage of fetal cells and estimate fetomaternal hemorrhage volume.
