This field is consistent with HbA-containing (adult) red cells lacking detectable F cells.

ddx.vs: A positive test shows scattered bright pink, hemoglobin-filled fetal cells among ghost cells, which are absent in this field.

ddx.dx: Hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin, pancellular
ddx.vs: Pancellular HPFH shows HbF evenly distributed so nearly all cells retain stain, whereas heterocellular elevations (e.g., thalassemia, sickle cell) show a mixed population.
Under-elution leaves many cells partially stained with intermediate intensity, whereas this field shows uniformly empty ghosts.

2179.recognize_zh: 高倍小腸絨毛的固有層與上皮內，被大量中型、核不規則有角、染色深的非典型淋巴球浸潤，並侵入表面上皮造成上皮空泡化，呈上皮親和性（epitheliotropism），支持腸道 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Lamina propria expanded by a dense infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei with small amounts of pale cytoplasm
Numerous atypical lymphocytes infiltrating the surface epithelium (epitheliotropism)
Surface epithelium vacuolated and disorganized
Congested capillaries; plasma cells and eosinophils not prominent
2179.describe_en: High-power section of small-intestinal mucosa shows villi whose lamina propria is expanded by a dense infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei and scant pale cytoplasm. Numerous similar cells infiltrate the surface epithelium, which appears vacuolated and disorganized. Congested capillaries are present, and inflammatory cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with involvement by an intestinal T-cell lymphoma, such as enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma; immunostains for CD3, CD4, CD8, CD56, CD30 and cytotoxic markers are recommended to confirm and subtype.

ddx.vs: MEITL cells are more monotonous, medium-sized with pale cytoplasm and are typically CD8+ CD56+, lacking celiac background; IHC separates it.

ddx.dx: Celiac disease or refractory celiac disease
ddx.vs: Celiac disease has increased intraepithelial lymphocytes that are small and cytologically bland without expansion of the lamina propria by atypical cells.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD consists of small bland lymphocytes in the lamina propria with little epitheliotropism and a low Ki-67 index.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric necrosis and is EBER positive, whereas EATL is EBV negative.

1987.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結：箭頭處的被膜下竇與中間竇被淡粉紅色的大型細胞群撐開，夾在殘存的深藍色濾泡與淋巴組織之間；這種竇內浸潤模式是 anaplastic 型 DLBCL 的低倍線索，必須用免疫染色與 ALCL、轉移癌區分。
features: Lymph node with capsule at right and residual dark blue follicles and lymphoid tissue
Pale eosinophilic aggregates of large cells within subcapsular and intermediate sinuses (arrows)
Sinusoidal distribution outlining residual lymphoid nodules
Partial rather than complete nodal effacement
Crush/fold artifact at the right edge; cytologic detail not resolved at this power
1987.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a thin capsule with residual follicles and lymphoid parenchyma. Pale aggregates of large cells expand the subcapsular and intermediate sinuses (arrows), outlining the residual lymphoid nodules, with partial nodal involvement. Crush artifact is present at the right edge, and cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. With a confirmed B-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, with a sinusoidal growth pattern.

ddx.vs: ALCL also favors sinuses but is CD30-positive with T-cell or null phenotype, lacks CD20/PAX5, and may be ALK positive.
Metastases in sinuses are keratin or S100/SOX10 positive and CD45 negative.
Sinus histiocytes are bland with small nuclei and abundant pink cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163 positive, without atypical large cells.

1859.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被一片大小較一致的中小型胚細胞佔滿，核質比極高、細胞質極少，染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，無顆粒與 Auer 小體，符合 B 淋巴母細胞白血病的典型（類 FAB L1）形態。
features: Packed sheet of small to medium blasts with relatively uniform size
Very high N:C ratio with scant, barely visible pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous nucleoli
No granules or Auer rods; scattered nucleated red cells and small lymphocytes
1859.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is replaced by a relatively uniform population of small to medium-sized blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Residual hematopoiesis is limited to occasional nucleated red cells. Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia with L1-type morphology, compatible with B-lymphoblastic leukemia pending confirmation by flow cytometry and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.vs: T-ALL cannot be distinguished reliably by morphology and requires cytoplasmic CD3 positivity with absent B-lineage markers.
Hematogones are admixed with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis and show a normal antigenic maturation pattern rather than a packed monotonous population.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of small-cell lymphoma (e.g., mantle cell)
ddx.vs: Mature lymphoma cells have more condensed chromatin and are TdT/CD34 negative with surface light-chain restriction.

1795.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一團細胞，每顆細胞核偏心、染色質細緻，細胞質豐富且呈藍色、邊界大致可辨，排列成片狀但彼此仍保有個別輪廓，符合造骨細胞（osteoblast）群聚。
features: Cohesive-appearing aggregate of medium to large mononuclear cells with abundant blue-gray cytoplasm
Round to oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with fine reticular chromatin and small nucleoli
Individual cell outlines partly discernible within the cluster; pale areas in the cytoplasm away from the nucleus may represent the Golgi zone
Low N:C ratio with relatively uniform nuclear size and shape
Background of red cells and a few small lymphocytes
1795.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of medium to large mononuclear cells with abundant blue-gray cytoplasm and round to oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Nuclear size is fairly uniform, and no significant pleomorphism or mitotic activity is seen. The distinct perinuclear clear zone typical of osteoblasts is not clearly resolved in this cluster. Findings are consistent with a cluster of osteoblasts, a normal marrow element seen more often in children and in areas of bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters show true cohesion with nuclear molding, pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli, and are keratin positive.
Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof adjacent to the nucleus, whereas the osteoblast clear zone is separated from the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Neuroblastoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Small round cell tumors have high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm, and rosette or molded arrangements unlike these cytoplasm-rich cells.

1667.recognize_zh: 周邊血液三顆漿細胞：核偏位、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質豐富深藍、核旁有淡染區（hof），其中下方細胞可見小核仁；在周邊血抹片看到這樣的漿細胞，應考慮漿細胞白血病。
features: Three circulating plasma cells of medium size
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; small nucleolus in the lower cell
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Distinct perinuclear hof (Golgi zone)
Background red cells and scattered platelets
1667.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant deep-blue cytoplasm with prominent perinuclear hofs; one cell shows a small nucleolus. Red cells and platelets in the background are unremarkable in this thin area. The presence of circulating clonal plasma cells is consistent with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate clinical context (5% or more circulating plasma cells), and confirmation of light-chain restriction by flow cytometry and cytogenetic risk assessment is advised.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, occur with other reactive lymphoid forms and show polytypic kappa and lambda expression.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have a more central nucleus, less abundant cytoplasm and lack a well-defined Golgi hof.

ddx.dx: Leukemic marginal zone or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show predominantly small lymphocytes with a CD19+/CD20+ clonal B-cell population rather than CD138+/CD19- plasma cells.

1475.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶部分核型圖，顯示第 9 與第 22 號染色體對：箭頭指出的第 9 號較正常同源染色體長（der(9)），第 22 號則有一條明顯變短（費城染色體 Philadelphia chromosome），代表 t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)，是 CML 的標誌。
features: Partial G-banded karyotype showing chromosome 9 and chromosome 22 pairs
Arrowed chromosome 9 longer than its normal homolog due to gained material on 9q (der(9))
Arrowed chromosome 22 shortened, representing the Philadelphia chromosome der(22)
Pattern indicates a reciprocal translocation t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
1475.describe_en: Partial G-banded karyotype shows the chromosome 9 and 22 pairs. One chromosome 9, indicated by the arrow, is longer than its homolog because of material translocated from 22q, and one chromosome 22 is shortened, representing the Philadelphia chromosome. These findings indicate the reciprocal translocation t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2), which generates the BCR::ABL1 fusion gene. In the appropriate clinical setting, this is diagnostic of chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive; the same translocation can also occur in B-lymphoblastic leukemia and rarely in AML.

63363.recognize_zh: 同一視野可比較三種細胞：左下分葉核、胞質粉紅帶細顆粒的嗜中性球；右下正常小淋巴球；上方一顆明顯較大的淋巴樣細胞，核質比高、染色質深且核輪廓略有皺褶，屬異常大型淋巴樣細胞（Sézary 細胞）。紅色箭頭指血小板。
features: Segmented neutrophil (lower left) with multilobed nucleus and pink cytoplasm containing fine granules
Normal small lymphocyte (lower right) with round dense nucleus and a thin rim of blue cytoplasm
Atypical large lymphoid cell (upper center), about twice the size of the small lymphocyte, with high N:C ratio and dense chromatin
The atypical cell's nucleus shows subtle folding/grooving; a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Two small platelets (red arrows); normocytic red cells in the background
63363.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil, a normal small lymphocyte and two platelets (red arrows) among unremarkable red cells. In addition, there is a large atypical lymphoid cell approximately twice the size of the normal lymphocyte, with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, dense chromatin, subtle nuclear folding and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Deep cerebriform grooves are not well resolved at this magnification. In the clinical setting of erythroderma, the atypical cell is consistent with a large Sezary cell of Sezary syndrome, and quantification by flow cytometry (CD4:CD8 ratio, CD7/CD26 loss) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, rather than scant cytoplasm with a convoluted nucleus.
ATLL cells show polylobated 'flower' nuclei and are associated with HTLV-1 infection rather than cerebriform nuclei with erythroderma.
T-prolymphocytes have a visible nucleolus and basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, with TCL1A overexpression.
Blasts have finely dispersed chromatin and nucleoli, whereas this cell has dense mature chromatin.

60931.recognize_zh: 視野中央與左下各有一個比紅血球還大、無核、帶紫色顆粒與淡藍邊緣的結構，對照旁邊的嗜中性球與一般小血小板，可認出是巨大血小板（giant platelets）。
features: Two anucleate platelets clearly larger than adjacent red cells (giant platelets), one central and one at lower left
Central giant platelet with a dense purple granular center and a pale blue, irregular peripheral hyalomere
Lower-left giant platelet with flattened, finely granular lilac cytoplasm and angular outline
Other scattered platelets are small, providing internal size comparison
Two segmented neutrophils and, at the left edge, a partially visible granulocyte with coarse purple granules; thick area with crowded red cells
60931.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a relatively thick area with crowded red cells, shows two platelets that exceed the diameter of adjacent red cells. The central platelet has a compact purple granulomere with a pale blue fringed rim, and the lower-left platelet is flattened with fine lilac granules. Other platelets are small, and two segmented neutrophils are present; a coarsely granulated granulocyte is partly visible at the left edge. Findings are consistent with giant platelets, which may reflect increased platelet turnover, a myeloid neoplasm or an inherited macrothrombocytopenia; correlation with platelet count and history is required.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a dense nucleus with a rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas giant platelets are anucleate with granular purple centers.
Micromegakaryocytes contain a dense, often lobulated nucleus, which is absent in these platelets.
A clump is composed of multiple discrete platelets with separate granulomeres, rather than a single large platelet with one continuous outline.

60291.recognize_zh: 視野中大多數紅血球周邊布滿許多短而等距、大小一致的鈍刺突起，細胞仍保持圓形，符合棘狀紅血球／鋸齒狀紅血球（echinocytes, burr cells）。
features: Majority of red cells show 10-30 short, evenly spaced, uniform projections around the circumference (echinocytes)
Cells retain a round outline with variable loss of central pallor
Diffuse involvement across the field, raising the possibility of in vitro artifact
Two neutrophils and a platelet present; neutrophils appear unremarkable
No fragments, agglutination or inclusions seen
60291.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows diffuse echinocytic change, with most red cells displaying numerous short, regularly spaced spicules around a round cell outline. Two neutrophils and a platelet are present. No schistocytes, spherocytes or target cells are prominent. Findings are consistent with echinocytes (burr cells); because the change is uniform across the field, a storage or slide-drying artifact should be excluded before attributing it to uremia, pyruvate kinase deficiency or post-transfusion change.

ddx.vs: Acanthocytes are small dense cells with few irregularly spaced projections of varying length, whereas echinocytes have many short uniform projections.
Artifact is indistinguishable in shape but typically involves all cells in a region and disappears on a fresh, rapidly dried smear.
Keratocytes have one or two horn-like projections from a ruptured vacuole rather than many evenly distributed spicules.

131.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中沿骨小樑旁（paratrabecular）與間質呈片狀浸潤的大型異型淋巴細胞，核不規則、染色質空泡狀、核仁明顯並有分裂像；免疫染色凸顯骨小樑旁帶狀的腫瘤細胞，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤轉化為瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的骨髓侵犯。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, 2 to 3 times the size of a small lymphocyte, with irregular, cleaved or lobulated nuclei
Vesicular chromatin with one or more prominent nucleoli and frequent mitotic figures
Diffuse sheet-like infiltrate hugging bony trabeculae (paratrabecular) and extending interstitially, with residual trilineage hematopoiesis in intertrabecular spaces
IHC (membranous and nuclear markers) highlights the neoplastic population in a paratrabecular band while sparing central fat-rich marrow
Hypercellular marrow with foci of hemorrhage; background eosinophil precursors and megakaryocytes in residual marrow
131.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power is hypercellular with a dense lymphoid infiltrate that is predominantly paratrabecular and forms broad sheets, while residual intertrabecular marrow retains fat and trilineage hematopoiesis. At high power the infiltrate is composed of large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular and cleaved nuclei, vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and numerous mitoses, without small centrocyte-predominant follicular aggregates. Immunohistochemical stains (membranous and nuclear markers, antibodies not labeled in the images) highlight the large-cell infiltrate in a paratrabecular distribution and are negative in the residual hematopoietic marrow; a further stain shows variable cytoplasmic/perinuclear positivity in the large cells. In a patient with prior follicular lymphoma, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, representing histologic transformation of follicular lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma, low grade, involving marrow
ddx.vs: Shows paratrabecular aggregates of predominantly small cleaved centrocytes, whereas here the paratrabecular infiltrate consists of sheets of large cells with nucleoli and mitoses.

ddx.dx: De novo diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; transformation is supported by prior FL history and shared clonal markers such as t(14;18)/BCL2 rearrangement and identical light chain.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia or myeloid sarcoma
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts have finer chromatin and express MPO/CD34/CD117 without B-cell markers, and lack the paratrabecular growth seen here.
Forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is keratin-positive and CD45/CD20-negative, unlike this discohesive lymphoid infiltrate.

captions: Trephine biopsy, H&E low power: hypercellular marrow with a dense paratrabecular lymphoid infiltrate and focal hemorrhage.
H&E medium power: sheets of atypical lymphoid cells along a bony trabecula with residual hematopoiesis at upper left.
H&E high power: large lymphoid cells with irregular cleaved nuclei, vesicular chromatin, nucleoli and a mitotic figure.
Membranous IHC: sheets of positive large lymphoid cells, sparing residual hematopoietic marrow below.
Membranous IHC low power: positive cells concentrated around trabeculae (paratrabecular pattern).
Nuclear IHC low power: strongly positive paratrabecular bands of tumor cells with negative central marrow.
Cytoplasmic/membranous IHC low power: diffuse paratrabecular positivity of the infiltrate.
IHC high power: large atypical cells with variable weak cytoplasmic and perinuclear staining and one strongly positive cell.

67.recognize_zh: 成片的大型細胞帶偏心核、泡狀染色質與明顯中央核仁，細胞質嗜雙色（amphophilic），伴壞死與星空樣巨噬細胞；免疫染色上腫瘤細胞 CD138 類膜狀強陽性、B 細胞標記陰性，EBER 原位雜交陽性，符合漿母細胞淋巴瘤（plasmablastic lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse sheets of large, discohesive-to-cohesive neoplastic cells with geographic necrosis
Large cells with eccentric nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent central nucleoli (plasmablastic/immunoblastic)
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies with tingible-body macrophages (starry-sky)
Pan-B-cell marker negative in tumor cells, with strong membranous/cytoplasmic plasma-cell marker (CD138-type) staining
Strong nuclear staining in most tumor cells with a nuclear marker (e.g., MUM1/MYC); scattered reactive T cells/histiocytes highlighted by other stains
Nuclear dark signal in tumor cells on in situ hybridization, consistent with EBER positivity
67.describe_en: Sections of the maxillary sinus mass show diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with areas of geographic necrosis. At high power, the cells have eccentric, round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin, prominent central nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; mitotic figures, apoptotic debris, and tingible-body macrophages are numerous. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells lack pan-B-cell marker expression and show strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining with a plasma-cell marker (CD138 pattern) and diffuse strong nuclear staining with a nuclear marker; small reactive T cells and histiocytic/dendritic cells are highlighted separately. In situ hybridization shows nuclear signal in the tumor cells, consistent with EBER positivity. Findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma typically has serum/urine M-protein, lytic bone lesions, marrow clonal plasma cells, and is usually EBER-negative, whereas this lesion is EBER-positive.
Immunoblastic DLBCL expresses CD20 and PAX5, whereas the tumor cells here are negative for pan-B-cell markers and positive for plasma-cell markers.
Also CD20-negative and CD138-positive with plasmablastic morphology, but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK staining and is EBER-negative.
Morphology and CD138+/CD20- phenotype overlap, but PEL is HHV8 (LANA-1) positive, which should be excluded by immunostaining.

67.stain: H&E; IHC (B-cell, CD138-type, nuclear markers); ISH: EBER
captions: H&E, low power: diffuse sheets of large cells with geographic necrosis
H&E, high power: plasmablastic cells with vesicular nuclei and central nucleoli
H&E, high power: sheets of large cells with eccentric nuclei and tingible-body macrophages
IHC: tumor cells negative for a pan-B-cell marker with rare positive cells
IHC: tumor cells essentially negative, single strongly positive background cell
IHC: tumor cells negative; scattered small reactive cells positive (T-cell/leukocyte marker pattern)
IHC: strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining in tumor cells (CD138 pattern)
IHC: strong nuclear staining in most tumor cells (e.g., MUM1/MYC)
In situ hybridization: nuclear signal in tumor cells, consistent with EBER
IHC: tumor negative; interspersed histiocytic/dendritic cells highlighted

3.recognize_zh: 骨髓以大量無顆粒、無 Auer 小體的芽細胞為主，形態無法判定系列；流式顯示 CD34+、HLA-DR+、CD7+，但 MPO、CD19 與 cytoplasmic CD3 均為陰性，缺乏任何系列特異標記，符合未分化型急性白血病。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei and fine, dispersed chromatin
Small inconspicuous nucleoli in some blasts
Scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Aspirate is densely packed by monotonous blasts with scattered smudged cells
Flow: CD45-dim blasts, CD34+, HLA-DR+, CD7+; cytoplasmic MPO, CD19 and cytoplasmic CD3 negative
3.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm; red cells are normocytic and platelets are present. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by a monotonous population of medium-to-large blasts with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and pale basophilic cytoplasm lacking granules or Auer rods. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-dim blast population positive for CD34, HLA-DR and CD7, and negative for cytoplasmic MPO, CD19 and cytoplasmic CD3. The absence of lineage-assigning markers is consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia, provided a full panel (including cCD79a, CD22, cCD3, lysozyme, CD41/CD61) and genetic studies exclude a defined entity.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical, but AML-M0 expresses at least two myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33 or CD117, which must be excluded by a broader panel.
ETP-ALL shares CD7 and CD34 but expresses cytoplasmic CD3, which is negative here.
MPAL requires expression of lineage-defining markers of two lineages (e.g., MPO plus cCD3 or strong CD19), whereas these blasts express none.
BPDCN blasts are usually CD34 negative and express CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4, distinguishing them from these CD34+ blasts.

captions: Peripheral blood: two agranular blasts with high N:C ratio
Bone marrow aspirate, low power: sheets of blasts
Bone marrow aspirate, high power: agranular blasts with fine chromatin
Flow cytometry: CD34+, HLA-DR+, CD7+ blasts negative for MPO, CD19 and cCD3

65219.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結有萎縮退化的生發中心與增厚、呈同心圓排列的外套區（Castleman 樣變化），插圖 LANA 在外套區散在陽性漿母細胞；另一區可見擴張、內含蛋白質液體的薄壁淋巴管樣腔隙，襯以扁平但核呈 HHV-8/LANA、ERG 陽性的內皮細胞，呈淋巴管擴張型卡波西肉瘤。
features: Low power (A): lymphoid follicles with regressed germinal centers and expanded concentric mantle zones; inset HHV-8/LANA shows scattered positive nuclei in mantle zones
Low power (B): focus of dilated vascular/lymphatic spaces filled with pink proteinaceous material between lymphoid parenchyma
High power (C and inset): thin-walled spaces lined by bland flattened to slightly plump spindle endothelial cells; no marked atypia
D: HHV-8/LANA stippled nuclear positivity in lining spindle cells
E: ERG nuclear positivity confirming endothelial lineage
F: D2-40 (podoplanin) staining of lining cells, supporting lymphatic differentiation
65219.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show follicular hyperplasia with regressed, depleted germinal centers and expanded mantle zones, in which LANA immunostain highlights scattered HHV-8-positive plasmablasts. Separately, there is a small focus of dilated, thin-walled lymphatic-like spaces containing proteinaceous material, lined by bland flattened endothelial cells. The lining cells express HHV-8/LANA, ERG and D2-40. The findings are consistent with KSHV/HHV-8-associated multicentric Castleman disease with concurrent nodal Kaposi sarcoma, lymphangiectatic pattern.

ddx.vs: Benign lymphatic lesions share dilated D2-40-positive channels but the endothelial nuclei are HHV-8/LANA-negative.

ddx.dx: Vascular transformation of lymph node sinuses
ddx.vs: Sinus vascular transformation shows anastomosing capillary-like sinusoidal channels, usually with sclerosis, and is LANA-negative.
Reactive HIV lymphadenopathy may have follicle lysis but lacks LANA-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones.
These show confluent sheets or large clusters of LANA-positive plasmablasts rather than the scattered single plasmablasts seen here.

62915.recognize_zh: 這不是形態圖，而是一張血液分析儀的全血計數報表：血紅素 6.3 g/dL、RBC 2.09 的重度貧血，但 MCV 90.1 fL 正常、RDW 13.1 正常，RBC 直方圖峰位正常；重點在於維生素 B12 缺乏合併缺鐵或先前補充綜合維生素時，末梢血可能看不到巨球性變化，須靠骨髓判讀。
features: Automated hematology analyzer printout (CBC with 5-part differential), not a morphologic image
RBC 2.09 x10^12/L, Hb 6.3 g/dL, Hct 18.8% (severe anemia) with normal MCV 90.1 fL, MCH 30.1 pg, MCHC 33.4 g/dL and RDW 13.1%
RBC volume histogram with a single peak in the normal range without a macrocytic shift
WBC 5.3 x10^9/L with relative neutrophilia (76.3%) and lymphopenia; flag for immature granulocytes/bands
Platelets 214 x10^9/L, MPV 7.7 fL (low-flagged); reticulocyte values not reported
62915.describe_en: This figure is an automated complete blood count printout rather than a morphologic image. It shows severe normocytic, normochromic anemia (Hb 6.3 g/dL, MCV 90.1 fL, RDW 13.1%) with a unimodal RBC histogram, normal white cell count with relative neutrophilia and lymphopenia, an immature granulocyte flag, and a normal platelet count. The absence of macrocytosis and anisocytosis does not exclude megaloblastic anemia, because concurrent iron deficiency or prior multivitamin/folate supplementation can mask macrocytosis in the peripheral blood while megaloblastosis persists in the marrow. Interpretation requires correlation with vitamin B12, folate and iron studies, reticulocyte count, smear review (hypersegmented neutrophils, dimorphic red cells) and, if indicated, bone marrow examination.

ddx.vs: Normocytic anemia of inflammation has low serum iron with high ferritin and normal B12/folate, and the marrow lacks megaloblastic erythroid and giant metamyelocyte changes.
These show reticulocytosis (and hemolysis markers), whereas megaloblastic anemia has inappropriately low reticulocytes with elevated LDH from ineffective erythropoiesis.
MDS can show normocytic or macrocytic anemia with megaloblastoid change but has normal B12/folate, persistent dysplasia after replacement, and often cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Combined iron deficiency and B12 deficiency (dimorphic anemia)
ddx.vs: Mixed deficiency gives a normal MCV but typically a raised RDW and a dimorphic smear, so a normal RDW here argues for prior partial treatment.

62595.recognize_zh: 這是一張 PET 軸切面影像（非形態圖）：腹部/骨盆橫切面中，箭頭指向病人左前方一個邊界清楚的局部高度 FDG 攝取病灶，雙側上肢橫切面也在畫面兩側；單一高代謝腸道腫塊對應移植後漿細胞瘤樣 PTLD 的病灶，並可作為切片定位與治療追蹤依據。
features: Axial PET image at the level of the abdomen/pelvis with both arms seen in cross-section laterally
Single well-circumscribed focus of intense FDG uptake in the left anterior abdomen (arrow)
Otherwise low-level diffuse background activity without additional discrete hypermetabolic foci in this slice
No anatomic CT correlation shown; SUV values not provided
62595.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic axial PET image through the abdomen/pelvis. It shows a single, well-circumscribed focus of intense FDG avidity in the left anterior abdomen (arrow), with otherwise low-grade background uptake and no other discrete hypermetabolic lesions in this slice. Without fused CT and SUV measurements the precise anatomic location cannot be determined from this image alone. In the clinical context of a transplant recipient, the lesion corresponds to the biopsied mass-forming plasmacytoma-like EBV-positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, and PET is used for staging and response assessment.

ddx.dx: Physiologic bowel or urinary tract (ureter) activity
ddx.vs: Physiologic uptake is usually linear or segmental and changes on delayed imaging or CT fusion, whereas a lymphoma mass is focal, round and corresponds to a soft-tissue lesion.
FDG uptake cannot separate infection from PTLD, so tissue biopsy is required.
Carcinomas are also FDG-avid; histology with hematolymphoid markers (CD138, light chains, EBER) versus cytokeratin distinguishes them.

1731.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的細胞有圓形、未分葉的核，胞質被粗大、大小一致的顆粒填滿並蓋到核上，這是嗜酸性骨髓球（eosinophilic myelocyte）；早期嗜酸性顆粒常偏紫深色，易被誤認為嗜鹼性球，下方可見顆粒偏橘紅的較成熟嗜酸性細胞作對照。
features: Arrowed cell with a round to oval, non-lobated nucleus and moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with coarse, uniform, round granules that appear dark purple-brown (immature eosinophilic granules)
Granules evenly distributed, extending to the cell margin
Adjacent larger precursor with fine chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm (promyelocyte/early precursor)
Nearby eosinophilic precursor with coarse orange-red granules for comparison; marrow aspirate background
1731.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an eosinophilic myelocyte (arrow) with a round, non-lobated nucleus and cytoplasm filled with coarse uniform granules, some of which have a darker, basophilic hue typical of immature eosinophil granules. An adjacent early myeloid precursor and a more mature eosinophilic cell with orange-red granules are present for comparison. The granules are round and uniform rather than irregular and water-soluble. Findings represent a normal eosinophilic myelocyte.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are fewer, irregular, deep purple-black, obscure the nucleus, and are often partially dissolved, while eosinophil granules are uniform and round with an orange tint when mature.
Neutrophilic myelocytes have fine lilac specific granules with a paranuclear clear zone, not coarse refractile granules filling the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophils in AML with inv(16)
ddx.vs: Inv(16) eosinophils show large, dark basophilic-staining granules admixed with eosinophilic ones in immature cells, together with increased blasts.
Mast cells are larger with an oval central nucleus and dense purple metachromatic granules, often spindle-shaped, and are tryptase and CD117 positive.

2499.recognize_zh: 低中倍率切片中大片細胞邊界清楚、胞質豐富淡粉紅的組織球樣細胞呈片狀排列，其間散佈大量胞質鮮紅的嗜酸性球，中央有一塊小淋巴球聚集區；片狀淡染細胞加嗜酸性球是蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的線索，但此倍率看不到核溝，需 CD1a/langerin 確認。
features: Sheets of medium to large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Numerous scattered cells with bright red granular cytoplasm consistent with eosinophils
Central focus of small dark lymphocytes with a few multinucleated or larger cells
Nuclear grooves and folding not resolvable at this magnification
No necrosis or granulomas evident in this field
2499.describe_en: Section at low to intermediate power shows sheets of cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and well-defined borders, admixed with numerous eosinophils, and a central aggregate of small lymphocytes containing a few larger cells. Nuclear detail, including the characteristic grooved or coffee-bean nuclei, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Necrosis or eosinophilic abscesses are not clearly seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation requires immunohistochemistry for CD1a, langerin (CD207), and S100, and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are larger with emperipolesis and are S100+ but CD1a- and langerin-negative, usually with abundant plasma cells.
CHL has scattered CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in an eosinophil-rich background rather than sheets of CD1a+ histiocytes.
ECD shows foamy CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis and is CD1a-negative.

ddx.dx: Kimura disease or eosinophilic granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: These have eosinophils without sheets of grooved Langerhans cells and are CD1a-negative.

2051.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組織化學染色中，淋巴結內可見大量緊密排列、背靠背的圓形結節，結節呈深棕色陽性、結節間較淡，呈現擁擠濾泡的結構；未標示抗體，若為 BCL2，濾泡陽性支持濾泡性淋巴瘤，但本圖染色背景偏棕、對比有限。
features: Low-power view of numerous closely packed, round to oval nodules (follicles)
Nodules show darker brown immunostaining than the internodular areas
Follicles are crowded and back-to-back with little intervening tissue
Nodules are relatively uniform in size and shape
Diffuse light brown background staining limits contrast; antibody not specified
2051.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows effacement of architecture by numerous closely packed, relatively uniform follicles that stain more intensely than the internodular areas. The specific antibody is not indicated, and diffuse background staining reduces contrast; cytologic detail cannot be assessed. If this represents BCL2, positivity within germinal center-like nodules supports neoplastic follicles, as reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative. Findings are consistent with a follicular growth pattern in keeping with follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show mantle zones and polarization, and have BCL2-negative germinal centers.
NLPHL shows large vague nodules of small B cells with scattered CD20+ LP cells that are BCL2 negative.
Nodular MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive and CD10 negative, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+/BCL6+.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Colonized follicles are surrounded by pale marginal zone cells that are CD10 and BCL6 negative, with residual follicular dendritic meshworks.

62531.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中可見一大片淡染區，由細胞質豐富、淡嗜酸性的大型組織球組成，核圓、呈泡狀並有小核仁，部分細胞質內含有完整的淋巴球（emperipolesis）；周圍為小淋巴球與漿細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病（SHML）。
features: Expanded pale zone (distended sinus) filled with large histiocytes, contrasting with surrounding dense small lymphocytes
Histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with small but distinct nucleoli; no nuclear grooves
Intact lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis) focally evident
Background of small lymphocytes and plasma cells in the medullary cords
62531.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E section of lymph node shows a large pale area corresponding to a distended sinus, populated by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, round vesicular nuclei, and small distinct nucleoli. Scattered histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis). The surrounding parenchyma contains numerous small lymphocytes and plasma cells. There is no significant nuclear atypia, necrosis, or eosinophil-rich infiltrate. Findings are consistent with sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy (Rosai-Dorfman disease); confirmation with S100 positivity and CD1a/langerin negativity is recommended.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are smaller with grooved, coffee-bean nuclei and scant emperipolesis, are accompanied by eosinophils, and are CD1a/langerin positive.
Reactive sinus histiocytes lack prominent emperipolesis, large vesicular nuclei, and S100 positivity.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Metastatic cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and express keratin or melanocytic markers (SOX10, HMB45), unlike bland S100+/CD68+ RDD histiocytes with emperipolesis.
ALCL cells show hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, marked atypia, mitoses, and strong CD30 (with or without ALK) expression.
